instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya kutengeneza ripoti za hisa inayotoa taarifa na uchambuzi wa hisa. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kutafuta na kufupisha taarifa za hisa, na kutengeneza ripoti za hisa zilizobinafsishwa kulingana na mahitaji ya mtumiaji. Watumiaji waweze kuingiza misimbo au majina ya hisa, kuchagua muundo na maudhui ya ripoti, na tovuti itatengeneza ripoti husika kiotomatiki. Ripoti zijumuishe 'Basic Stock Information', 'Market Trends', 'Financial Data' na mengineyo. Weka rangi ya mandharinyuma kuwa 'white' (nyeupe) na rangi ya vipengele kuwa 'navy' (buluu iliyokolea). Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana kwenye tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa KIINGEREZA, na majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe yaliyotolewa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike vilevile kama yalivyoandikwa.

ui_instruct.task: Verify the stock search functionality by entering a valid stock code.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system returns relevant stock information and analysis corresponding to the entered stock code, displaying details such as basic stock information, market trends, and financial data.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The system provides options for various report formats and content customization, enabling users to choose according to their preferences.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The website successfully recognizes the stock name, retrieving and displaying the relevant stock information and analysis.

ui_instruct.task: Generate a customized stock report by choosing specific elements to include (e.g., market trends, financial data).
ui_instruct.expected_result: The generated report correctly includes the selected elements, accurately reflecting the user's specified choices.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate through the website and test all buttons function correctly by clicking each of them and back to the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each click on a button leads to the appropriate page or action without any errors, ensuring smooth navigation.

ui_instruct.task: Evaluate the website's form inputs by submitting incomplete or incorrect stock information.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system displays appropriate error messages and guidance on how to correct the input errors, ensuring robust input validation.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'navy', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: Kabla hatujaendelea, tuweke kundi maalum la maonyesho ili tuwe tunaangalia namba zilezile kila wakati — hisa hizi nane haswa, nitaongeza nyingine baadaye: Argent Micro (ARGN, 'Technology', $84.50, P/E 31.4, 'Market Cap' $142B, 'Dividend Yield' 0.0%), Baltic Freight (BLTC, 'Industrials', $23.75, P/E 9.8, $8B, 4.2%), Comet Energy (CMET, 'Energy', $61.20, P/E 12.6, $54B, 5.1%), Driftwood Retail (DRFT, 'Consumer Goods', $9.15, P/E 22.0, $2B, 1.8%), Ember Semiconductor (EMBR, 'Technology', $147.30, P/E 41.7, $210B, 0.4%), Fjord Pharma (FJRD, 'Healthcare', $33.60, P/E 12.6, $18B, 2.5%), Greenline Utilities (GRNL, 'Utilities', $54.80, P/E 15.5, $27B, 3.9%), na Helix Software (HLXS, 'Technology', $58.90, P/E 27.3, $65B, 1.1%). Kisha nipe ukurasa kamili unaoitwa 'Screener': visanduku vya kuteua sekta ambapo hisa inapita ikiwa ipo katika sekta yoyote iliyoteuliwa, visanduku vya kuandika P/E ya juu kabisa na 'Dividend Yield' ya chini kabisa ambavyo vyote lazima vitimie kwa pamoja, kisomo cha moja kwa moja cha 'X of 8 match' kinachofuata kila mabadiliko, na safu zinazoweza kupangwa ambapo kupanga kwa P/E kunavunja sare kwa alfabeti ya alama ya hisa. Nikibofya safu ya matokeo niingie moja kwa moja kwenye kutengeneza ripoti ya hisa hiyo. Pia nataka mipangilio miwili ya ndani — 'Dividend Payers' kwa 'Dividend Yield' ya angalau 2.5% na 'Cheap Tech' kwa hisa za 'Technology' zenye P/E chini ya 35 — pamoja na uwezo wa kuhifadhi mipangilio yangu mwenyewe yenye majina na kuiendesha tena baadaye. Sheria ya nyumbani kuanzia sasa: kila asilimia mahali popote kwenye programu hii, 'Dividend Yield' ya leo au 'Gain' na 'Weight' wowote tutakaoongeza, inaonyeshwa kwa desimali moja na alama ya %, kama 4.2%, kamwe siyo 4.20% wala 4%.
follow_ups.source_feature: Equity screener with multi-criteria filtering (fused with Simply Wall St's curated investing themes as built-in presets)

follow_ups.instruction: 'Screener' tayari inazaa matunda — sasa nahitaji mahali pa kuweka hisa ninazozifikiria. Ongeza ukurasa wa 'Watchlist' wenye makundi mawili, 'Core' na 'Speculative'; anza na Comet Energy na Fjord Pharma katika 'Core' na Helix Software katika 'Speculative', na weka dokezo kwenye Fjord Pharma linalosema 'watch Q3 margins'. Nataka kitufe cha 'Add to Watchlist' chenye kichaguzi cha kundi kwenye kila safu ya matokeo ya 'Screener' na kwenye ripoti yoyote iliyotengenezwa, na kama hisa tayari ipo kwenye orodha usitengeneze safu ya pili — niambie tu kwamba tayari imehifadhiwa. Kwenye 'Watchlist' yenyewe niruhusu kuhariri madokezo, kuhamisha hisa kutoka kundi moja hadi jingine, na kuondoa maingizo. Mtindo mwingine wa nyumbani kuanzia sasa: kila mara hisa inapoonekana mahali popote kwenye programu hii, onyesha alama yake ya hisa kwenye beji ndogo ya rangi ya 'navy' (buluu iliyokolea) mbele ya jina, kama [FJRD] Fjord Pharma — kila mahali, ikiwa ni pamoja na chochote tutakachojenga baadaye.

follow_ups.instruction: Sasa tuifanye 'Watchlist' izungumzie pesa: ongeza mwonekano wa 'Positions' ambapo kila hisa iliyo kwenye orodha inapata kisanduku cha 'Shares' na kisanduku cha 'Buy Price', na kila kitu kinahesabiwa upya ninapoandika — 'Market Value' kwa bei ya sasa ya hisa, 'Gain' au hasara kwa dola na kwa asilimia, 'Weight' ya kila safu ndani ya 'Portfolio' nzima, na safu ya jumla. Pakia nafasi zangu halisi kuanza: 50 CMET zilizonunuliwa kwa $48.00, 100 FJRD kwa $36.50, na 45 HLXS kwa $52.25. 'Weight' inaonyeshwa kwa desimali moja lakini lazima daima ijumlishe kuwa 100.0% haswa — pale mviringisho wa kawaida unapokuacha kwenye 99.9 au 100.1, rekebisha ile iliyokuwa karibu zaidi kuviringishwa upande mwingine. Kisanduku cha 'Shares' kikiwa tupu au sifuri, safu hiyo inatolewa tu kwenye jumla bila NaN wala hitilafu popote, na namba hasi zinakataliwa. Pia, jambo la msingi kwa programu nzima kuanzia sasa: orodha yoyote ya hisa ambayo sijachagua mpangilio wake inaonyeshwa kwa alfabeti ya alama ya hisa.

follow_ups.instruction: Ni wakati wa ile picha ya afya ninayoendelea kuichora kwenye karatasi. Jenga ukurasa wa 'Ratings' unaozipa hisa zote nane alama 0-5 katika vipimo vitano na kuzipanga pamoja. 'Value' inatokana moja kwa moja na P/E — chini ya 10 ni 5, kuanzia 10 hadi chini ya 15 ni 4, 15 hadi 25 ni 3, 25 hadi 35 ni 2, na 35 au zaidi ni 1; 'Dividend' inatokana na 'Dividend Yield' — sifuri haswa ni 0, chini ya 1% ni 1, kuanzia 1 hadi 2% ni 2, 2 hadi 3% ni 3, 3 hadi 4.5% ni 4, na 4.5% au zaidi ni 5. Kwa 'Growth', 'Profitability' na 'Financial Health' tumia namba zangu za mchambuzi, kwa mpangilio huo: Argent 5/3/4, Baltic 2/4/5, Comet 1/4/3, Driftwood 3/2/2, Ember 5/5/4, Fjord 4/3/4, Greenline 1/3/5, Helix 4/5/3. Onyesha alama tano za kila hisa kama pentagoni au chati ya rada pamoja na jumla kati ya 25 na daraja la herufi — 20 au zaidi ni A, 16 hadi 19 ni B, 12 hadi 15 ni C, 8 hadi 11 ni D, chini ya 8 ni E — na panga ukurasa kuanzia jumla bora zaidi, ukivunja sare kwa alfabeti ya alama ya hisa. Ukiwa humo, ongeza chaguo la 'Health Score' kwenye utengenezaji wa ripoti ili ripoti iliyotengenezwa iweze kujumuisha pentagoni na daraja la hisa hiyo.

follow_ups.instruction: Sasa 'Alerts', ili 'Watchlist' ijifuatilie yenyewe. Hisa yoyote iliyo kwenye 'Watchlist' yangu inaweza kubeba kanuni za 'Alerts' — chagua hisa, kipimo ('Price', P/E au 'Dividend Yield'), juu au chini, na kiwango kinachoandikwa — zinazoweza kutengenezwa moja kwa moja kutoka safu ya 'Watchlist' au ndani ya 'Alerts Center' kipya, ambapo kichaguzi cha hisa kinatoa tu zile zilizo kwenye 'Watchlist'. Kanuni inapimwa dhidi ya namba za sasa za hisa mara tu inapotengenezwa na tena kila ninapoihariri, na juu/chini ni vikali: namba iliyo sawa kabisa na kiwango HAIJAWASHWA. Nianzishie kanuni tatu: 'Price' ya CMET chini ya $65 (hiyo ipo hai, bei ni 61.20), 'Dividend Yield' ya FJRD juu ya 3%, na P/E ya HLXS chini ya 25. 'Alerts Center' kinaonyesha kila kanuni na muhtasari wa hali unaoonyesha ni ngapi zipo 'Triggered' dhidi ya ngapi zipo 'Watching', na kanuni iliyo 'Triggered' inaweza kuondolewa hadi sehemu tofauti ya 'History' huku muhtasari ukibaki sahihi wakati wote.

follow_ups.instruction: Ongeza kitovu cha 'Earnings Call Highlights'. Kila moja ya hisa hizi nane ipewe nukuu mbili fupi zilizoandaliwa kutoka simu zao za mwisho za mapato, lakini panga maneno kwa makusudi: 'automation' inaonekana katika nukuu nne haswa — zote mbili za Ember Semiconductor, moja ya Argent Micro, moja ya Helix Software — 'tariffs' inaonekana tu katika nukuu za Baltic Freight, na hakuna nukuu yoyote inayotaja 'crypto'. Kisha nipe kisanduku cha kutafuta kinacholinganisha moja kwa moja ninapoandika bila kujali herufi kubwa au ndogo, kikipanga matokeo kwa hisa huku neno lililopatikana likiangaziwa, idadi ya vinavyolingana kwa kila hisa na jumla kuu, vikipangwa kuanzia yenye vinavyolingana vingi zaidi na sare zikivunjwa kwa alfabeti ya alama ya hisa. Kisanduku kikiwa tupu kinialike tu kutafuta, na neno lisilo na matokeo lipate ujumbe wazi wa 'no results', kamwe siyo skrini tupu. Ukiwa humo, ruhusu utengenezaji wa ripoti ujumuishe sehemu ya 'Earnings Highlights' yenye nukuu za hisa hiyo.

follow_ups.instruction: Nimekuwa nikizunguka kati ya ripoti ili kupima hisa moja dhidi ya nyingine — badala yake nijengee zana ya 'Compare'. Niruhusu kuchagua hisa mbili hadi nne na kupata safu wima zilizo pamoja zenye safu za 'Price', 'Market Cap', P/E, 'Dividend Yield', na jumla ya 'Health Score' kutoka kazi ya 'Ratings', zikihesabiwa upya papo hapo kila ninapoongeza au kuondoa hisa. Bora katika kila safu iangaziwe — P/E ya chini kabisa inashinda, 'Dividend Yield' ya juu kabisa inashinda, jumla ya juu kabisa ya 'Health Score' inashinda — na sare halisi iangazie hisa zote zenye sare hiyo. Juu yake weka hesabu ya ushindi kwa kila hisa ikihesabu safu ngapi imeshinda, huku sare zikihesabiwa kwa wote waliomo; ikiwa hisa moja tu au hakuna iliyochaguliwa, onyesha ujumbe wa kirafiki wa kuchagua nyingine zaidi badala ya gridi tupu au iliyovunjika.

follow_ups.instruction: Wakati wa kubadilisha sura, mtindo wa Koyfin. Weka kibadilishi cha mwanga/giza kwenye kichwa cha kila ukurasa: hali ya giza ibadilike kuwa mandharinyuma ya buluu nzito iliyokolea ('deep navy', #0B1B33) yenye maandishi mepesi, na chaguo hilo lazima libaki ninapohama kati ya kurasa. Katika hali zote mbili, vitufe vikuu vya vitendo — 'Generate Report', kuendesha au kutumia kichujio cha 'Screener', 'Add to Watchlist', kuhifadhi kanuni ya 'Alerts' — viwe rangi ya kaharabu (#F0A92D) na maandishi ya buluu nzito iliyokolea ('dark navy'); vichwa vya kurasa na vichwa vya sehemu viwe herufi kubwa zenye nafasi pana kati ya herufi; na kila kadi au paneli ipate pembe za mviringo za 12px na mpaka mwembamba unaoonekana. Hakikisha beji za alama za hisa zinabaki zinasomeka hata katika hali ya giza — zipe rangi nyepesi zaidi ndani au mstari wa nje ili zisipotee kwenye mandharinyuma. Hii inahusu programu nzima — ukurasa wa ripoti, 'Screener', 'Watchlist', ukurasa wa 'Ratings', 'Alerts Center', yote, bila kurasa zilizofanywa nusu.

follow_ups.instruction: Malizia yote kwa 'Command Center' kama ukurasa wa kutua — mtazamo mmoja, vigae vinne. Kigae cha 'Portfolio' chenye jumla ya 'Market Value' na 'Gain' ya jumla kutoka 'Positions' zangu, kigae cha 'Alerts' kinachoonyesha ni kanuni ngapi zipo 'Triggered' kati ya jumla, kigae cha 'Top Rated' kinachotaja hisa yenye 'Health Score' bora zaidi na daraja lake, na kigae cha 'Watchlist' chenye idadi ya kila kundi. Kila kigae ni njia ya mkato kwenda ukurasa wake, na namba haziwezi kupitwa na wakati — nikiondoa kanuni ya 'Alerts' au kubadilisha idadi kwenye 'Shares' kisha nikarudi, vigae lazima vionyeshe hilo. Na katika upakiaji wa kwanza safi, kigae kiwe tayari kimejaa kutoka kila kitu tulichopanda, siyo sifuri wala vishika nafasi.

target_app_summary: What began as a simple stock-report generator has grown into a full retail-research workstation over a fixed eight-stock demo universe. A multi-criteria screener with built-in and saved presets feeds a grouped watchlist, which in turn powers a live portfolio positions calculator and a strict-threshold alerts workflow; a five-dimension health-score ratings engine flows into generated reports, a side-by-side compare grid, and the landing Command Center that rolls up portfolio value, alert status, top rating, and watchlist counts. Orthogonal growth includes an earnings-call transcript keyword search wired into report sections and a full light/dark theming pass across every surface. The feature graph runs one chain four deep (base app, then screener, then watchlist, then positions, then command center), with the ratings and alerts branches reconverging at the dashboard and the restyle touching five earlier surfaces.

follow_ups.source_feature: Odds Comparison Across Sportsbooks
follow_ups.instruction: Utabiri ni mzuri sana, lakini mimi hulinganisha bei, kwa hiyo nipe ukurasa kamili wa 'odds board' wenye mechi za wikendi zikiwa zimepangwa kuanzia 'Friday' hadi 'Sunday'. Pakia hizi sita haswa, odds za ushindi za timu mwenyeji zikiorodheshwa kwa mpangilio wa BetNova, HoopLine, CourtSide (nitaunganisha data halisi baadaye): Fri Celtics @ Knicks, modeli yetu inaipa Knicks 58%, -130 / -125 / -135; Fri Lakers @ Bulls, Bulls 44%, +140 / +145 / +140; Sat Suns @ Heat, Heat 51%, -105 / -110 / -102; Sat Nuggets @ Raptors, Raptors 38%, +170 / +165 / +170; Sun Warriors @ Mavericks, Mavericks 62%, -150 / -155 / -148; Sun Bucks @ Hornets, Hornets 47%, +120 / +118 / +125. Angazia 'best price' ya mwenyeji katika kila mechi pamoja na kampuni inayoitoa (kama kampuni mbili zinalingana kwa 'best price', ziweke alama zote mbili), na onyesha 'implied win probability' inayotokana na 'best price' hiyo, kwa desimali moja. Kanuni mbili za nyumbani kwa kila kitu kwenye app hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: odds ziwe daima katika mfumo wa Kimarekani zikionyesha alama (+145, -125, kamwe si desimali), na mechi ziandikwe daima kama timu ngeni @ timu mwenyeji.

follow_ups.source_feature: Best Bets Highlighter
follow_ups.instruction: Huu ndio ukurasa wa pesa. 'betting recommendations' unayonipa sasa yanarudia tu timu ambayo modeli inaipenda, bila kujali bei hata kidogo — jenga upya kipengele hicho kiwe 'Best Bets': panga wenyeji wote sita kulingana na 'edge' — uwezekano wa ushindi wa modeli ukiondolewa uwezekano unaodokezwa na 'best price' inayopatikana, ukionyeshwa kwa pointi za asilimia kwa desimali moja na kwa alama, kama +3.2 — na weka beji kwa tatu za juu. follow_ups.source_feature: Spread Range Filter (fused with Back-to-Back Game Filter and Head-to-Head Historical Matchup Query)
follow_ups.instruction: Hatua kubwa: utafutaji wa historia ya mechi uliojenga unaniambia nani alishinda na hakuna kingine, kwa hiyo ukuze uwe 'research center' kinachopima kila mkutano dhidi ya soko la kubeti. Nachagua timu mbili na kila mkutano wa zamani uliopo kwenye faili unapata uchambuzi kamili — matokeo, 'spread' ya mwisho ya timu ya kwanza na kama iliifunika, mstari wa jumla ya pointi na kama ilipita juu, chini, au ilitua hasa kwenye namba yenyewe ('push' ni 'push', kamwe isichanganywe upande wowote), pamoja na kama timu ya kwanza ilikuwa kwenye 'back-to-back'. Juu ya orodha kuwe na 'summary strip' wenye 'record' za 'straight-up', 'against-the-spread', na 'over/under', pamoja na idadi ya 'meetings' inayoonekana kati ya jumla yote; chini yake, dirisha la 'spread' ya chini/juu ninaloandika mwenyewe na kisanduku cha 'back-to-back' pekee vinavyopunguza orodha kwa pamoja, huku 'record' hizo zikihesabiwa upya kwa vinavyoonekana tu. Pakia faili la Knicks-Celtics kwa upande wa Knicks: ushindi 112-108 (-3.5, ilifunika; 220 kwenye mstari wa 221.5, chini; ilikuwa imepumzika), kushindwa 99-121 (+2.5, haikufunika; 220 kwenye 224.5, chini; 'back-to-back'), ushindi 105-103 (+6.5, ilifunika; 208 kwenye 210.5, chini; 'back-to-back'), kushindwa 114-118 (-1.5, haikufunika; 232 kwenye 232, 'push'; ilikuwa imepumzika), ushindi 96-94 (+4.5, ilifunika; 190 kwenye 195.5, chini; ilikuwa imepumzika), kushindwa 120-130 (+7.5, haikufunika; 250 kwenye 243.5, juu; 'back-to-back') — jozi nyingine yoyote ionyeshe maelezo nadhifu kwamba 'no-meetings-on-file'. Kiunganishe pia na ubao: kila kadi ya mechi pale ipate 'research link' inayotua hapa kikiwa kimechuja mapema timu zake mbili, na pale jozi ninayoichunguza inapokutana pia kwenye ratiba ya wikendi hii, weka bango la mechi hiyo pamoja na 'best price' yake.

follow_ups.source_feature: Best Bets Highlighter (extended into edge watch alerts)
follow_ups.instruction: Naendelea kukosa nafasi za kuingia habari zinapobadilisha namba. Nipe 'Alerts' za 'watch': kila beti kwenye 'Best Bets' ipate kitendo cha 'watch' ambapo naandika 'target edge', na beti zinazofuatiliwa zibebe alama ya 'watched' hapo hapo kwenye orodha. Ukurasa wa 'Alerts' ukusanye ufuatiliaji wangu wote — kila mmoja ukionyesha beti yake, lengo, na 'edge' ya papo hapo ya beti hiyo, pamoja na marekebisho yangu — wenye kidonge cha hali kulingana na kanuni ya nyumbani: kijani na 'fired' mara tu 'edge' ya papo hapo inapofika lengo au kulizidi, kaharabu na 'armed' wakati bado haijafika. Malengo yasiyofaa — tupu, herufi — yakataliwe kwa ujumbe, kila ufuatiliaji uhesabiwe upya papo hapo marekebisho yanapobadilisha 'edge', na kuondoa ufuatiliaji kwenye ukurasa wa 'Alerts' kufute pia alama yake kwenye 'Best Bets'.

follow_ups.source_feature: Against-the-Spread (ATS) Record Display (adapted into a personal performance ledger)
follow_ups.instruction: Tiketi zinaongezeka, kwa hiyo nijengee ukurasa wa 'Performance' unaotokana na 'My Tickets': 'net profit' au hasara, ROI kama 'profit' juu ya 'total staked' kwa desimali moja, 'record' yangu ya jumla ya ushindi na kushindwa, na mgawanyo wa 'singles' dhidi ya 'parlays', pamoja na 'settled-ticket ledger' chini ya namba kuu likiorodhesha kila tiketi iliyotatuliwa na 'stake' na 'profit' au hasara yake ya dola yenye alama. Tiketi zilizotatuliwa pekee — tiketi iliyo katika hali ya 'pending' isihesabiwe popote hadi iamuliwe — na chukulia 'profit' kama fedha taslimu: 'profit' au hasara ya kila tiketi ifungwe hadi senti mara tu inapotatuliwa, na kila jumla kwenye ukurasa ijumlishe viasi hivyo vya senti. Kila kitu kihesabiwe upya mara tu ninapomaliza kitu. Jaza daftari mapema kwa tiketi tatu zilizotatuliwa ili ukurasa usiwe mtupu siku ya kwanza: beti ya pekee ya $25 kwenye Mavericks kwa 'best price' yao iliyoshinda, beti ya mchanganyiko ya $10 kwenye Knicks na Bulls kwa 'best price' iliyopoteza, na beti ya pekee ya $15 kwenye Hornets kwa 'best price' iliyoshinda.

target_app_summary: The basketball prediction site grows into a full line-shopping and bet-management platform. A pinned six-game weekend odds board carrying the base model's win probabilities and home moneylines at three sportsbooks becomes the data spine: a parlay slip books legs at best prices, the base betting-recommendations feature is rebuilt into a Best Bets value-edge ranking, an adjustments panel lets users override model probabilities and re-rank the edges live, and watch alerts with typed target edges flip between fired and armed as those numbers move. A ticket-placement workflow with a bankroll feeds a Performance analytics page (ROI, records, singles-vs-parlays, a cent-locked settled-ticket ledger), while the base match-history lookup is upgraded into a matchup research center grading past meetings against closing lines with ATS/over-under records and push handling, deep-linked from the board. A final emerald rebrand sweeps every surface including the original rankings page. The graph roots at the base app: predictions -> board -> slip -> tickets -> performance (5 deep from T1) and board -> edge finder -> adjustments -> watch alerts.

global_rules.rule: Odds are always displayed in American form with an explicit sign (+145, -125), never as decimal odds, everywhere in the app.
Matchups are always written as away team @ home team on every surface.
Any status anywhere is shown as a colored pill: amber for pending/in-progress, green for won/positive, red for lost/negative.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza dashibodi ya nishati ya jua inayoonyesha 'real-time data' na 'historical data'. follow_ups.source_feature: Module-level alert system (panel-level performance view)
follow_ups.instruction: Dashibodi ni nzuri, lakini sasa nataka kuona paneli zangu halisi — zile zilizo nyuma ya namba za uzalishaji. Nipe ukurasa wa 'Panels' unaoorodhesha kila paneli na safu yake, wati zake za kadirio, na uzalishaji wa wiki hii, pamoja na jumla kwa kila safu na kwa 'fleet' — uzalishaji na jumla ya wati za kadirio — na anza na hizi sita hasa, nitaongeza nyingine baadaye: safu ya 'South' ina 'Peak 1' (400 W, 14.00 kWh wiki hii), 'Ridge West' (400 W, 13.20 kWh) na 'Ridge East' (350 W, 11.55 kWh); safu ya 'East' ina 'Gable 1' (350 W, 9.80 kWh), 'Corner 2' (300 W, 9.00 kWh) na 'Chimney 3' (300 W, 5.40 kWh). Zipange kwa 'yield' — yaani kWh za wiki kwa kila kW ya uwezo wa kadirio, kwa desimali moja — bora zaidi kwanza, na paneli mbili zikilingana kwa 'yield' panga kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti. Jambo moja linalotumika kila mahali kwenye programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: nishati kila wakati isomeke kama kWh yenye desimali mbili hasa, hivyo 'Corner 2' ionyeshe 9.00 kWh, kamwe si 9 kWh.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Panels page and read the ranked panel list from top to bottom.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The order is Peak 1 (yield 35.0), Ridge East (33.0), Ridge West (33.0), Corner 2 (30.0), Gable 1 (28.0), Chimney 3 (18.0) — Ridge East sits above Ridge West on the alphabetical tiebreak, and Corner 2 sits above Gable 1 even though Gable 1 produced more kWh.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, compare the rows for Corner 2 and Gable 1.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Corner 2 (yield 30.0) is ranked above Gable 1 (yield 28.0) despite Gable 1's higher weekly output (9.80 kWh vs 9.00 kWh), showing the ranking uses kWh per rated kW rather than raw output.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, find the rollup figures for the South array, the East array, and the whole fleet.
ui_instruct.expected_result: South shows 38.75 kWh, East shows 24.20 kWh, and the fleet shows 62.95 kWh with a total rated capacity of 2,100 W — the two array totals sum exactly to the fleet total.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, read Corner 2's weekly output figure.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads exactly 9.00 kWh — two decimals with the kWh unit, not 9 kWh or 9.0 kWh — and the other energy figures on the page also carry two decimals.

ui_instruct.task: In the historical data section, enter a start date and an end date to run a query.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A chart or trend view for the selected period is displayed without errors.

follow_ups.source_feature: Financial Payback Calculator
follow_ups.instruction: Nimependa. Inayofuata: ukurasa wa 'savings calculator' — naandika 'electricity rate' yangu kwa dola kila kWh na 'system cost', nacho kinahesabu 'yearly savings' na 'payback'. Tumia jumla ya wiki ya 'fleet' kutoka ukurasa wa 'Panels' mara 52 kupata kWh za mwaka, onyesha pesa kwa dola zenye desimali mbili, na toa 'payback' kwa miaka na miezi, ambapo mwezi usiokamilika unapandishwa juu. Kihesabu upya ninapoandika, bila kitufe cha kutuma. Na sheria ya nyumbani kuanzia sasa, mahali popote kwenye programu: nikiandika kitu kisicho sahihi — herufi, 'rate' sifuri, hasi — usifute matokeo, acha namba nzuri za mwisho zibaki na uonyeshe tu noti ndogo kuhusu ingizo baya.

follow_ups.source_feature: Module-level alert system
follow_ups.instruction: Ile paneli yangu ya 'Chimney 3' inanitia wasiwasi, kwa hiyo jenga 'alert center'. Kuwe na eneo la kanuni ambapo naandika kizingiti cha 'yield' — paneli yoyote yenye 'yield' ya wiki iliyo chini kabisa ya kizingiti hicho izue tahadhari, kukaa sawasawa na namba yenyewe bado ni sawa, na iwe tahadhari moja kwa kila paneli hata kama kanuni kadhaa zinaikamata — pamoja na orodha ya tahadhari zilizo hai na kumbukumbu tofauti ya zilizotatuliwa, ambapo kila tahadhari inataja paneli na 'yield' yake. Nianzishie kanuni moja ya 25.0 iliyokwisha wekwa. Nikikubali tahadhari, niulize nithibitishe kwanza, kisha ihamie kwenye kumbukumbu ya zilizotatuliwa, na uonyeshe idadi ya tahadhari zilizo hai hapo hapo kwenye urambazaji. Ah, na kuanzia sasa kwenye programu nzima: kila hali ipate kitone cha rangi pamoja na neno kando yake — kitone chekundu 'Active', kitone cha kijani 'Resolved', kwa mtindo huo — kamwe rangi peke yake.

follow_ups.instruction: Sasa nionyeshe namba zinazofurahisha: ukurasa wa 'environmental impact'. follow_ups.instruction: Sasa ile ya kufurahisha: ukurasa wa 'power flow' wa moja kwa moja — mchoro wenye uhuishaji wa paneli, betri, nyumba na gridi, wenye namba ya sasa kwenye kila mtiririko, kwa kW yenye desimali mbili. Nipe vigezo vitatu vya kuchezea: 'sun level' kama asilimia, 'home load' kwa kW, na 'battery percent', yenye chaguo-msingi la 60. Uzalishaji ni uwezo wa kadirio wa 'fleet' kutoka ukurasa wa 'Panels' ukipimwa kwa 'sun level'; ziada huchaji betri hadi ifikie 100 kisha humwagika kwenda gridi, ilhali upungufu humwaga betri hadi kikomo cha 20 kabla ya kuvuta kutoka gridi. Chochote nitakachoandika, namba lazima zilingane — kile paneli zinazalisha pamoja na kile betri au gridi inachochangia daima kinalingana na kile nyumba inachotumia pamoja na kile kinachohifadhiwa au kusafirishwa, moja kwa moja ninapoandika.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Generation reads 2.10 kW, the home takes 1.50 kW, the battery charges at 0.60 kW, and the grid shows 0.00 kW — the flows add up exactly.

ui_instruct.task: Type 50 into the sun level and 3.00 into the home load, leaving the battery at 60.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Generation reads 1.05 kW and the 1.95 kW shortfall is covered by the battery discharging, with the grid at 0.00 kW — generation plus battery discharge equals the home's 3.00 kW.

ui_instruct.task: Type 100 into the battery percent, 100 into the sun level, and 1.00 into the home load.
ui_instruct.expected_result: With the battery already full, the 1.10 kW surplus flows entirely to the grid as export and the battery flow reads 0.00 kW.

follow_ups.source_feature: System Health Status Indicator
follow_ups.instruction: Kusanya kila kitu kwenye ukurasa wa 'System Health' wenye alama moja. Anza na 100, ondoa 15 kwa kila tahadhari hai iliyopo kwenye 'alert center', na ondoa 10 zaidi kama wastani wa 'yield' ya 'fleet' — wastani sahili wa 'yield' za paneli — uko chini ya 30.0. Alama 90 na zaidi isomeke 'Healthy', 75 hadi 89 ni 'Watch', chini ya 75 ni 'Fault', na nataka makato yaorodheshwe ili nione sababu, pamoja na mstari wa kazi kwa kila tahadhari hai na mmoja kwa 'yield' ndogo ya 'fleet' kama hiyo inanipunguzia alama. Nikienda kukubali tahadhari, alama iwe imeshasasishwa kufikia ninaporudi kwenye ukurasa.

ui_instruct.task: Open the System Health page on a fresh load and read the score and its breakdown.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score is 75 with a Watch health read (75 lands in Watch, not Fault), broken down as 100 minus 15 for the one active alert (Chimney 3) minus 10 because the fleet's average yield of 29.5 is under 30.0.

ui_instruct.task: On the System Health page, read the to-do list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Exactly two to-do lines show — one for the active Chimney 3 alert and one for the low fleet average yield — matching the two deductions in the breakdown.

ui_instruct.task: Compare the displayed score with the deduction lines on the System Health page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score equals 100 minus the sum of the listed deductions — the breakdown shown is internally consistent with the headline number.

ui_instruct.task: Go to the alert center, acknowledge the Chimney 3 alert and confirm, then return to the System Health page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score rises to exactly 90 with a Healthy read (90 is the Healthy boundary), and the to-do list drops to a single line about the low fleet yield.

ui_instruct.task: Open the environmental impact page and read the weekly and annual CO2 figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The weekly figure reads 25.18 kg (62.95 kWh x 0.4) and the annual projection reads 1.31 t — the 1,309.36 kg crosses the 1,000 kg line so it shows in tonnes with two decimals, not as 1,309.36 kg and not rounded to 1.3 t.

target_app_summary: The solar dashboard has grown into a full home-solar operations platform. A panel fleet registry with per-array rollups and yield rankings became the backbone: it feeds a live-typing savings and payback calculator, a threshold-based alert workflow with rules, an active list and a resolved log, a copyable panel report builder, an expected-vs-actual performance overlay on the historical chart, an environmental impact page that converts fleet output into CO2 avoided and tree equivalents, a physics-honest power flow simulator, and finally a System Health score that reconciles the alert center and fleet yields into one graded number with to-dos. A design refresh mid-way moved the whole app from honeydew to a cream-and-amber card system. The graph is hub-and-spoke around the registry (T2, itself built off the base dashboard, feeds every later turn) with one deep chain rooted at the base — base to registry to alert center to health score — so early breakage compounds; three app-wide conventions (two-decimal kWh, invalid-input-never-blanks, dot-plus-word statuses) are tested silently on every new surface.

restyles the panels page
restyles the calculator page

global_rules.rule: Energy values are always displayed as kWh with exactly two decimals (9.00 kWh, 62.95 kWh) everywhere in the app.
Invalid input never blanks a result anywhere: the last valid output stays on screen alongside a small note about the bad input.
Every status or health indicator is a colored dot plus a word (red dot 'Active', green dot 'Resolved'), never color alone.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza mchezo wa mkakati wa kivinjari unaotegemea maandishi ambapo wachezaji wanaweza kuchagua kabila, kusimamia rasilimali, kuboresha na kupigana. Mchezo uwe na kurasa kadhaa, zikiwemo 'base page', 'ranking page', 'store', 'train page', 'workers page', 'upgrades page', 'bank page', 'messages page' na 'reports page'. Wachezaji wanaweza kuchagua kati ya makabila manne: 'Humans', 'Dragonborns', 'Elves' na 'Dwarfs', kila moja likiwa na sifa zake za kipekee. Wachezaji wanaweza kusimamia rasilimali kama 'Gold', 'Iron', 'Wood' na 'Wheat', na wanaweza kuboresha mji wao, wafanyakazi wao na askari wao. Buni tovuti ukitumia 'seashell' kama mandharinyuma na 'crimson' kwa vizuizi vya maudhui. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe ninayoyatoa kwenye maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

follow_ups.instruction: Geuza 'reports page' kuwa kumbukumbu halisi ya vita, ikiwa na mapigano sita haya tu na si mengine — nitaandika mengine baadaye: 'Day 2', niliwashinda Ashen Elves, nikapoteza askari 12, nikapora Gold 380 na Iron 220; 'Day 4', niliishinda Grimfang Horde, nikapoteza 18, Gold 265 na Iron 340; 'Day 5', niliushinda Stonebeard Clan, nikapoteza 9, Gold 410 na Iron 95; 'Day 7', niliwashinda Silverpine Sentinels, nikapoteza 21, Gold 505 na Iron 130; tena 'Day 7', nilishindwa na Duskwing Riders, wakafa 33, bila nyara; 'Day 9', nilishindwa na Ironhold Clan, wakafa 40, hakuna kitu. Yapange kuanzia siku mpya zaidi, na mapigano mawili yakiwa ya siku moja, panga kwa herufi za jina la mpinzani. Juu nataka muhtasari: 'win rate' ya wakati wote na kiwango cha 'recent form' kinachohusu siku tatu za mwisho za mapigano tu — siku, zingatia, siyo mapigano, hivyo kila pigano la siku hizo linahesabiwa (asilimia nzima, hivyo 4 kati ya 6 inasomeka 67%), jumla ya Gold na Iron zilizoporwa, jumla ya askari waliopotea, pamoja na kiasi ambacho Iron yangu yote ingeleta kwa yule mfanyabiashara uliyemjenga — kiwango kilekile cha Iron 3 kwa Gold 1, hesabu ileile ya kukata kwanza kisha kuzungusha chini. Sheria mbili zaidi za nyumba kwa mchezo mzima kuanzia sasa: matokeo ya pigano yaoneshwe kila mara kwa beji ya kijani ya 'Victory' au beji nyekundu ya 'Defeat', na kila kitu kinachohusu wakati kipigwe muhuri kama siku ya mchezo, mfano 'Day 9', kamwe siyo tarehe halisi ya kalenda.

follow_ups.instruction: Nijengee ukurasa wa 'battle simulator' unaocheza upya pigano zima papo kwa papo kwa kila herufi ninayobonyeza — bila kitufe cha kutuma, makadirio yanajiunda upya ninapoandika tu. Naingiza idadi ya washambuliaji wangu, idadi ya watetezi, na asilimia ya bahati kati ya -25 hadi 25 (chochote nje ya kipimo hicho au kisicho namba kikataliwe kwa ujumbe). Ari ni watetezi kugawanya washambuliaji mara 100, ikizungushwa na kubanwa kati ya 30 na 100, ikihesabiwa mara moja tu kutoka namba nilizoandika — na ioneshwe kwenye makadirio. Kisha pigano liendeshwe raundi baada ya raundi hadi upande mmoja umalizike kabisa: kila raundi watetezi wanapoteza robo ya nguvu yangu halisi ya sasa ikizungushwa juu — yaani washambuliaji wangu waliobaki mara ari kugawanya 100 mara (1 + bahati/100) — huku mimi nikipoteza robo ya idadi yao ya sasa pamoja na bonasi yao ya kudumu ya ulinzi ya 10%, ikizungushwa juu. Mapigo ya pande zote mbili yanatokea raundi ileile, na kama pande zote mbili zikifika sifuri kwa pamoja, watetezi wanashikilia uwanja. Nioneshe kumbukumbu kamili ya majeruhi raundi kwa raundi pamoja na idadi iliyobaki imesimama, ikimalizika kwa matokeo, raundi zilizopiganwa na walionusurika. Watetezi sifuri ni 'Victory' ya papo hapo bila pigano lolote, kabla ya hesabu yoyote ya ari kuendeshwa — usiache mgawanyo ulipuke. Na uongeze 'rematch picker' inayoorodhesha wapinzani kutoka kumbukumbu yangu; nikichagua mmoja, idadi ya watetezi ijazwe mapema kwa mara mbili ya askari niliowapoteza kwao — kiite makadirio ya walinzi ya wapelelezi wetu.

follow_ups.instruction: Wakati wa siasa sasa. target_app_summary: The text-based strategy game has grown from a resource-and-battle skeleton into a full empire sim. The bank became a live merchant exchange with cut-before-round conversion math; the reports page became a seeded war chronicle whose six pinned battles feed almost everything downstream: salvage expeditions harvest debris from its victories, a Hall of Plaques tiers its aggregates, a round-by-round battle simulator pre-fills rematches from its opponents, alliance join letters quote its record, and a power score counts its victories. On top sit alliance diplomacy with tagged rivals on the ranking, a Territories module whose outposts re-sort the ranking live with alphabetical tiebreaks, a royal war-room restyle unifying five pages, and a Herald's Proclamation composer that publishes a live-valued summary of the chronicle, plaques, power/rank and alliance state to the messages page. The feature graph is hub-shaped around the chronicle (T3) with two chains three deep (T1-T3-T5-T10 and T1-T3-T9-T10).

global_rules.rule: Any action that spends or converts resources shows the exact numbers involved and requires an explicit confirm before it applies, everywhere in the app.
Battle outcomes are always shown as a green Victory badge or a red Defeat badge, on every surface where an outcome appears.
Anything time-related is stamped in game-day form like 'Day 9' — never a real calendar date — everywhere in the app.

follow_ups.instruction: Watu wanaotumia 'credit score inquiry' daima huuliza kitu kilekile baadaye — sawa, lakini kwa kweli inaweza kupanda kiasi gani? Nipe ukurasa wa 'Score Improvement Estimator': wanaandika 'current score' (kubali 300 hadi 850 pekee) pamoja na idadi ya 'collections', 'late payments' na 'hard inquiries' waliyo nayo, na 'projected score' ikokotolewe upya papo hapo wanapoandika — +25 kwa kila 'collection' tutakaloondoa, +15 kwa kila 'late payment', na +5 kwa kila ulizo, lakini kamwe zaidi ya 850 — kisha ipendekeze mpango kulingana na ongezeko la jumla: chini ya pointi 40 ni 'Basic', 40 hadi 75 ni 'Standard', zaidi ya 75 ni 'Premium'. Iunganishe na 'credit score inquiry' ulioujenga tayari: mtu akiwasilisha uchunguzi, mpe kitufe cha 'project my improvement' kinachofungua kikokotoo na alama yake ikiwa tayari imejazwa (ongeza sehemu ya 'current score' kwenye uchunguzi kama haiombi bado). Na kanuni mbili za nyumbani kwa kila kitu kwenye programu hii kuanzia sasa, pamoja na chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: kila alama ya mkopo inayoonyeshwa mahali popote ipate kiwango chake kando yake — chini ya 580 'Poor', 580-669 'Fair', 670-739 'Good', 740-799 'Very Good', 800 na zaidi 'Excellent', kama '612 (Fair)' — na kila fomu au kifaa kibaki na kitufe kinachoonekana cha 'Start over' kinachokirudisha katika hali tupu kabisa.

follow_ups.instruction: Inayofuata: ukurasa wa 'Dispute Letter Builder' ili wageni waandae wenyewe barua zao za pingamizi kwa mashirika ya mikopo. Wanachagua shirika (Equifax, Experian, au TransUnion), wanachagua sababu — 'Not my account', 'paid in full', 'incorrect balance', 'duplicate entry', au 'identity theft' — kisha wanaandika 'creditor name' na 'account number', na muhtasari wa barua ujijenge upya wanapoandika, ukiishia katika kizuizi cha maandishi kinachoweza kunakiliwa. Namba za akaunti ziwe tarakimu pekee, kuanzia 4 hadi 16; kitu kingine chochote kitiwe alama ya hitilafu na isitoke barua yoyote inayotumika. Tia kila barua sahihi 'reference code': kiambishi cha shirika (EQ, EX, au TU), kistari, herufi nne za kwanza za mdai kwa herufi kubwa, kistari, kisha idadi ya tarakimu za 'account number' — hivyo Equifax pamoja na Capital One pamoja na 44127788 hutoa EQ-CAPI-8. Jambo moja zaidi: iunganishe na fomu ya wateja watarajiwa iliyo kwenye ukurasa wa nyumbani — mara mtu anapowasilisha fomu hiyo, mstari wa saini wa barua utie saini jina alilotoa hapo kiotomatiki, na hadi pale hakuna aliyewasilisha, ionyeshe kishikilia nafasi '[Your Name]' mahali pa saini.

target_app_summary: What began as an old-lace-and-rosy-brown lead-gen brochure site for a credit repair company has grown into a full client acquisition and service portal. Discovery and conversion now run through a live score-improvement estimator wired to the original credit score inquiry, a tie-aware filterable success-stories directory, and a checkout-style plan enrollment flow that inherits the estimator's plan recommendation. Service delivery grew its own arm rooted in the original lead form: the form's submitted name auto-signs the dispute letter builder's letters, saved letters feed a Draft/Sent/Resolved dispute tracker, and the tracker in turn drives both an impact dashboard and a per-creditor dispute strategy advisor that rolls cases up by creditor, ranks them by a priority score with a multi-bureau bonus, and derives each creditor's next move. A consultation scheduler with per-advisor slot availability and a site-wide brand restyle round it out. The feature graph has one deep service chain (lead form -> letter builder -> tracker -> dashboard/advisor), a conversion chain (inquiry -> estimator -> enrollment), and three silent app-wide conventions (score band labels, '+N pts' gain formatting, Start-over resets) tested across every new surface.

lead form's submitted name auto-signs the generated dispute letters
saved letters become Draft dispute cases
aggregates the seven pinned success stories

restyles estimator page
restyles success stories page and plan badges
restyles letter builder page
restyles dispute tracker and status badges
restyles impact dashboard page
estimator's plan recommendation preselects the enrollment plan
advisor rolls live tracker cases into per-creditor next actions and priority rankings

global_rules.rule: Every displayed credit score carries its band label next to it — under 580 Poor, 580-669 Fair, 670-739 Good, 740-799 Very Good, 800+ Excellent — e.g. '612 (Fair)'.
Every form or tool surface keeps a visible 'Start over' control that resets it to its initial blank state.
Score gains always render with a leading plus sign and 'pts' suffix, e.g. '+84 pts'.

target_app_summary: The clinical office brochure site grows into a full patient-facing clinic hub. Discovery grows through a seeded seven-provider team directory with tie-aware experience ordering, a live header search over doctors, services and pages, and a Plan Your Visit page pairing the hours table with a weekly doctor-coverage grid (per-day totals and tie-aware fullest-day highlight); self-service grows through a live visit cost estimator and a validated appointment-request workflow (accepting-only providers, on-site-day and phone validation, self-pay pricing reuse, review step, My Requests statuses); operations grow through a front-desk Requests Board that tallies and resolves those requests, and a pinned/date-ordered notices center feeding the homepage. A site-wide brand restyle with homepage quick-link cards and an English/Espanol mode that reorders the directory for Spanish-speaking doctors round it out. The feature graph fans out from the provider directory (feeding estimator, planner, requests, search, board and language mode), with a three-deep chain from base nav through the directory and appointment workflow into the triage board.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya ukurasa mmoja ya kutangaza 'Fundraiser Day', ikijumuisha utangulizi wa tukio, ushuhuda wa wachangishaji, taarifa za ofa, na taarifa za kampuni. Tovuti iwe na vipengele kama vile kirusha picha kinachosogea chenyewe kuonyesha ofa, sehemu ya kuonyesha ushuhuda wa wachangishaji, na sehemu ya kuonyesha taarifa za kampuni. Watumiaji waweze kuvinjari tovuti ili kujifunza zaidi kuhusu tukio la 'Fundraiser Day'. Weka 'cornsilk' (nyeupe ya hariri ya mahindi) kama rangi kuu ya mandharinyuma na 'peru' (kahawia ya udongo) kwa vidhibiti. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe ninayotoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The introduction should clearly explain what Fundraiser Day is about, including its purpose and significance, aligning with the event's promotional goals.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The testimonials section should display real and relevant feedback from previous fundraiser participants, demonstrating positive experiences and successful outcomes.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The section should provide complete and correct details about the company, including its mission, background, and role in organizing Fundraiser Day.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to smoothly navigate between the introduction, testimonials, offers, and company information sections with no broken links or errors.

ui_instruct.task: Assess the website's content for relevance to the Fundraiser Day promotion.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All text and multimedia content should focus on promoting Fundraiser Day, eliminating any unrelated information that could detract from the event's promotion.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'cornsilk' as the background color and 'peru' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'cornsilk' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'peru', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: Tukio sasa linapokea michango halisi, kwa hiyo nataka sehemu ya 'Supporter Wall' iwe chini kabisa ya ushuhuda kwenye ukurasa. Ianze na michango hii minane, hii hasa — nitaongeza mingine baadaye: Maria Alvarez $250 (Timu ya River Runners, Clean Water), James O'Neil $145 (Timu ya Bright Sparks, Education), Maria Alvarez tena na $300 nyingine (River Runners, Clean Water), Priya Shah $500 (Bright Sparks, Education), Tom Becker $95 (River Runners, Food Relief), Lena Fischer $100 (Timu ya Green Hearts, Food Relief), Sam Waters $40 (Green Hearts, Clean Water), na Dana Cole $610 (Green Hearts, Education). Kila mtu aonekane ukutani mara moja tu akiwa na jumla ya yote aliyotoa, akiwa na beji kwenye kiingilio chake inayotaja daraja lake — Gold kwa $500 na zaidi, Silver kwa $100 na zaidi, Bronze chini ya hapo — na wapangwe katika sehemu za utambuzi zinazolingana za Gold, Silver, na Bronze, jumla kubwa zikitangulia ndani ya kila sehemu, na timu yao pamoja na lengo walilochangia vionyeshwe pia. Vitu viwili nataka viwe hivyo kila mahali kwenye programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: takwimu za dola daima ziwe na alama ya $ pamoja na koma kwa maelfu, na kila tunapopanga watu au timu kwa nafasi, sare zipangwe kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti.

follow_ups.instruction: Zile ngazi za ofa kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo zinapaswa kufanya kitu kweli — zigeuze kuwa 'pledge form' inayofanya kazi: bonyeza $25, $50, au $100 au andika custom amount (hakuna chini ya $5 — wazuie watu kwa upole wakijaribu), weka jina lako, chagua lengo linaloungwa mkono, na toa kisanduku cha kuteua cha kugharimia processing fee yetu, ambayo ni 2.9% pamoja na senti 30, ikizungushwa hadi senti. Muhtasari — kiasi, ada ikiwa imegharimiwa, na jumla — lazima ubadilike papo hapo unapobofya ngazi au kuandika tarakimu, siyo baada ya kutuma. Mtu anapochangia, mchango wake uende kwenye supporter wall na uungane na jumla yake iliyopo kama tayari yupo humo (hivyo beji yake inaweza kupanda daraja); michango haihitaji timu, inaweza kukaa ukutani bila timu. Onyesha lengo lililochaguliwa kama kichupo kidogo chenye rangi — 'steel blue' (buluu ya chuma) kwa Clean Water, 'plum purple' (zambarau ya plamu) kwa Education, 'olive green' (kijani ya zeituni) kwa Food Relief — na tumia rangi hizo hizo za vichupo kila mahali lengo linapoonekana kwenye programu hii kuanzia sasa.

target_app_summary: The one-page Fundraiser Day promo site grows into a full campaign platform for the event. A supporter wall with cumulative recognition tiers (seeded with eight pinned gifts) feeds a live pledge builder wired into the homepage offer tiers, and both feed a Campaign Pulse dashboard (total, goal progress, unique supporters, cause rollups, tie-aware team leaderboard). On top of the dashboard sit a Share Studio message composer that embeds live campaign stats and an Impact Report that floor-converts per-cause dollars into tangible units and reconciles with the dashboard. Around that core, the app grows sideways into a conflict-checking Day Schedule planner, a boolean-filtered Partner Coalition directory, and a validated Updates Hub subscription workflow, and a late visual refresh restyles the home page, wall, dashboard, and directory consistently. The graph has one deep money chain (wall -> pledges -> dashboard -> share/impact) plus three standalone modules and a four-surface restyle.

follow_ups.instruction: Watu wanapiga simu tu kuuliza usafi utagharimu kiasi gani, kwa hiyo hebu tuongeze ukurasa wa Instant Quote. Kwanza sanidi vifurushi vyetu sita — hivi hasa, nitavirekebisha baadaye: Quick Tidy $35/hr (msingi wa 60 min, mara moja), Sparkle Standard $42/hr (msingi wa 90 min, inafaa kwa marudio), Eco Fresh $48/hr (msingi wa 90 min, inafaa kwa marudio, kile chetu rafiki kwa mazingira), Office Refresh $48/hr (msingi wa 120 min, inafaa kwa marudio), Deep Shine $55/hr (msingi wa 120 min, mara moja), Move-Out Master $60/hr (msingi wa 150 min, mara moja). Kwenye ukurasa wa kadirio mimi huchagua kifurushi na kuandika idadi ya vyumba vya kulala na vya kuogea, nayo ihesabu upya ninapoandika — bila kitufe cha kuwasilisha: muda wote ni msingi pamoja na dakika 30 kwa kila chumba cha kulala na dakika 45 kwa kila chumba cha kuogea, na bei ni kiwango cha kila saa kikizidishwa na muda huo, hadi senti, hivyo Deep Shine yenye chumba 1 cha kulala na chumba 1 cha kuogea inakuja 3h 15m na $178.75. Vyumba vya kulala vinaweza kuwa 0 kwa studio, lakini kitu chochote ambacho si nambari kamili kutoka 0 hadi 10 katika mojawapo ya sehemu hizo kipate dokezo la upole 'enter a valid number' na bei isionyeshwe kabisa. Tabia mbili nazitaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: onyesha muda kama '3h 15m', kamwe si saa za desimali, na kila jina la kifurushi linapoonekana mahali popote, weka kiwango chake mara baada yake, kama 'Deep Shine ($55/hr)'.

target_app_summary: What started as a simple house-cleaning brochure site (booking, inquiry, status check, contact) has grown into a full service-business platform. Discovery and pricing grew an instant quote estimator over a fixed six-package catalog, a ZIP-based service-area checker that feeds travel fees into quotes, and a side-by-side package comparison table. Commerce grew a gift-certificate store with a balance ledger, a quote-to-checkout booking flow with certificate redemption math, and a membership plans configurator with recurring discounts. Social proof lives in a filterable reviews hub whose averages feed both the comparison table and an owner-facing Business Snapshot dashboard that rolls up booked revenue, outstanding certificate balances, and overall rating. A site-wide restyle (deep teal actions, bordered cards, uppercase headings, golden stars) unifies the grown surface area. The feature graph has one deep spine (estimator -> area fees -> checkout -> dashboard) plus reviews and certificates each feeding two downstream consumers.

Watumiaji waweze kuvinjari tovuti, kuona menyu, kujifunza kuhusu 'private poker room', kuona 'events and promotions', na kufanya uhifadhi wa nafasi au manunuzi mtandaoni. follow_ups.instruction: Menyu iko sawa kwa kokteli na chakula, lakini ukuta wetu wa bourbon unastahili ukurasa wake mwenyewe — jenga 'Bourbon Library' ambapo watu wanaweza kuchuja mkusanyiko mzima: visanduku vya kuteua mitindo (bourbon, rye, wheated — ukiteua mitindo miwili zinaonyeshwa chupa za mtindo wowote kati ya hiyo), pamoja na visanduku vya kuandika vya 'minimum proof' na 'maximum pour price' ambavyo vinaongezeka juu ya mitindo iliyochaguliwa, na kupanga kwa bei au kwa umri (bei zikilingana hupangwa kialfabeti, na chupa isiyo na taarifa ya umri huwekwa baada ya zote zenye umri). Anza na hizi nane hasa, nitaziongeza baadaye: Amber Creek Small Batch (bourbon, 92 proof, miaka 6, $12 kwa kipimo), Copper Stakes Single Barrel (bourbon, 110 proof, miaka 9, $18, mgao kwa wanachama pekee), Riverboat Reserve (bourbon, 100 proof, miaka 12, $22), High Card Rye (rye, 96 proof, miaka 4, $12), Dead Man's Hand Barrel Proof (bourbon, 128.4 proof, miaka 8, $26, kwa wanachama pekee), Velvet Ace Wheated (wheated, 90 proof, miaka 5, $14), Old Bluff Bottled-in-Bond (bourbon, 100 proof, miaka 6, $16), na Full House Toasted (bourbon, 104 proof, bila taarifa ya umri, $20). Kanuni mbili za nyumbani ninazozitaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii kuanzia sasa, kwa chochote tutakachoongeza: nguvu ya wiski daima isomeke kwa njia zote mbili, kama '92 proof (46% ABV)', na chochote kinachohusu wanachama pekee kivae lebo ndogo ya dhahabu ya 'Members Only'. Kama mchanganyiko wa vichujio haupati chochote, sema hivyo kwa upole badala ya kuonyesha ukurasa uliovunjika, na weka kiungo cha maktaba kwenye 'menu page' ili watu waipate kweli.

follow_ups.instruction: Wasio wanachama wanaendelea kuuliza kuhusu chumba cha poka, kwa hiyo hebu tutengeneze 'Guest Pass' ya usiku mmoja ya $40 — lakini iendeshwe kama rafu ya chipsi, si malipo mengine ya kawaida. Weka 'night board' ya Agosti: tarehe 1, 7, 8, 15, 22, 28 na 29 Agosti kila moja iwe na pasi 10, ambapo tarehe 8 Agosti tayari imebakiwa na moja ya mwisho kabisa, na 'tournament nights' zilizo kwenye kalenda, yaani 14 Agosti na 21 Agosti, zionekane zimewekewa alama ya 'tournament nights' na zisiweze kudaiwa kabisa. Kudai usiku ni mbofyo mmoja — pasi inaingia moja kwa moja kwenye rafu ya 'My Passes' ikionyesha tarehe yake, bei ya $40, na msimbo wake wa uthibitisho, na idadi iliyobaki ya usiku huo inapungua. Mipaka ya nyumbani: pasi moja kwa kila usiku kwa kila akaunti, na kamwe zisizidi pasi tatu hai kwa wakati mmoja, na kila kukataliwa kuelezwe kwa Kiingereza rahisi. Na kuachia pasi kuna maana vilevile: kughairi kutoka 'My Passes' kunarudisha usiku huo, idadi inapanda tena, na usiku uliokuwa umeandikwa 'sold out' unarudi kudaiwa mara tu pasi inapoachiwa.

target_app_summary: The All-In Bourbon Bar's brochure site has grown into a full club platform. Discovery grew a multi-criteria Bourbon Library screener that feeds an interactive Build-a-Flight tool and a rated Tasting Journal with a Top Shelf leaderboard. The poker side grew a tournament calendar with a real registration workflow, a one-click Guest Pass night board with claim caps and cancellations that reopen sold-out nights, all respecting tournament blackout nights, and a capstone Night Out Planner that assembles tournaments, saved flights, and plus-one passes into one costed, points-previewed itinerary. Commerce and loyalty grew a denomination-pick gift card studio with printed bonus tiers and a per-keystroke card preview and a Player's Ledger that rolls flights, registrations, and card purchases into a tiered points balance, and a site-wide 'card table' restyle unified the look. The graph's spine is T1->T2->T4->T7->T10, with the ledger (T7) fanning in from three earlier features and the planner (T10) fanning in from four.

Nataka kuhifadhi violezo vya ujumbe vyenye majina kwa kutumia vishikilizi — {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{company}} na {{deal_value}} ndivyo pekee vinavyoungwa mkono — pamoja na 'preview pane' inayosasishwa moja kwa moja ambapo nachagua mmoja wa wateja wangu watarajiwa na kuona maandishi yakijaa ninapoandika, si baada ya kuhifadhi tu; nikiandika kishikilizi kisichoungwa mkono, kiashirie papo hapo kwenye kihariri na ukatae kuhifadhi hadi kiondolewe. target_app_summary: The base lead-management CRM grows into a full sales platform. Discovery and prioritization come from an engagement scoring engine with per-lead activity logs (pinned six-lead seed) and later an Inbox/Pipeline triage split fed by a lead-capture form builder. Outreach grows into a template studio with live placeholder previews, trigger-based automation rules that send templates and create dated tasks, and an outreach hub with simulated open-tracking that feeds back into scores. Analytics grow into a weighted pipeline forecast with editable stage probabilities and a build-your-own KPI dashboard that must mirror the forecast. A mid-ladder app-wide restyle sweeps all surfaces. The graph has a deep chain (templates -> automation -> outreach hub) plus reconciliation edges (dashboard mirrors forecast; inbox exclusion constrains forecast, dashboard, and rankings).

edges.what: base leads table and status editing that scores/activities attach to
message-sending flow the templates plug into
settings page hosting probabilities; lead stages and deal values
saved templates with placeholders that rules send
lead status changes that trigger rules
leads, reports, settings pages restyled
score temperature tags restyled as pills
template studio restyled
forecast breakdown table restyled
tasks page restyled
automation-sent messages populate the hub feed
opens add +3 to the engagement score and re-rank
average engagement score tile aggregates scores
forecast tile must mirror the forecast page total
test-submit creates a real lead in the CRM
web-form submissions land in the Inbox
promotion adds value x stage probability to the forecast
inbox leads excluded from score rankings
inbox leads excluded from dashboard tiles

global_rules.rule: Every engagement score, anywhere it appears in the app, carries a temperature tag: 0-2 Cold, 3-5 Warm, 6+ Hot.
Leads are always written as first and last name, a middle dot, then company (e.g. 'Rosa Delgado · Brightline Media') everywhere they are referenced.
Wherever stages appear as a list (dropdowns, breakdowns, reports), they follow pipeline order New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Won, Lost — never alphabetical.

follow_ups.instruction: Orodha ya makala inahitaji kichujio cha kweli, si kile kisanduku cha kutafuta tu. Nianzishie na makala haya sita hasa, nitaongeza mengine baadaye: 'Taming React Re-renders' ya Priya Nair ('Web Development', #react #performance, 'Advanced', mionekano 8,400 kwa jumla na 320 wiki hii, maneno 1,800); 'SQL Indexing Demystified' ya Marcus Webb ('Databases', #sql #performance, 'Intermediate', mionekano 12,100 na 150 wiki hii, maneno 1,200); 'Intro to Binary Trees' ya Priya Nair ('Algorithms', #datastructures, 'Beginner', mionekano 3,300 na 540 wiki hii, maneno 900); 'Debugging Memory Leaks in Node' ya Elena Fox ('Web Development', #node #performance, 'Advanced', mionekano 6,750 na 540 wiki hii, maneno 2,100); 'REST vs GraphQL' ya Marcus Webb ('Web Development', #api, 'Intermediate', mionekano 15,600 na 90 wiki hii, maneno 1,500); na 'Understanding TCP Handshakes' ya Elena Fox ('Networking', #networking, 'Beginner', mionekano 980 na 210 wiki hii, maneno 600). Nataka kichagua cha kategoria, vibonye vya lebo vinavyoweza kubonyezwa, na kisanduku cha idadi ya chini ya mionekano ambapo naweza kuandika namba — kuchagua lebo mbili kunapaswa kupanua matokeo (lebo yoyote ikilingana inatosha) lakini vidhibiti vingine vinabana (kategoria NA lebo NA mionekano), pamoja na hesabu ya papo hapo ya zinazolingana, tena niruhusu kuhifadhi mkusanyiko wa vichujio kwa jina na kuurudisha baadaye, na kidhibiti cha kupanga kwa 'all-time views', "this week's views", au kichwa, ambapo mionekano inapolingana mpangilio unarudi kwa alfabeti ya kichwa. Aa, na vitu viwili ninavyotaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii kuanzia sasa, pamoja na chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: idadi ya mionekano ya elfu moja au zaidi ifupishwe kama 12.1k (desimali moja), na kitu chochote chenye kiwango cha ugumu kivae beji ya rangi — kijani kwa 'Beginner', kaharabu kwa 'Intermediate', nyekundu kwa 'Advanced'.

target_app_summary: The little technical-articles site grows into a full developer knowledge hub. Discovery gets deep: a multi-criteria article screener with saved presets and tie-aware sorting, plus a Trending This Week dashboard that scores articles from weekly views and emoji reactions. Community output becomes first-class: an emoji reaction system, a validated multi-step Share-a-Solution publishing flow, a contributor level system where reactions received and published solutions jointly gate Reader/Rising/Expert/Legend tiers (both conditions required, so the most-reacted author can still sit at Rising), and a curated Featured Queue that feeds the homepage. Personal tooling arrives with a bookmark-driven Reading List with rounded-up read times and progress tracking, and everything is capped by a Weekly Digest builder that auto-assembles trending, featured, and contributor-spotlight content behind per-section include/exclude toggles into a publishable digest with a live-rebuilding plain-text copy block. A mid-ladder site-wide restyle (dark slate header, teal actions, difficulty-colored card accents) must land consistently on every earlier surface. The feature graph runs deep: reactions feed trending, trending feeds the featured queue, and trending + featured + contributor levels all converge in the digest (T1->T3->T5->T8->T10).

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza jukwaa lisilotaja majina la mazungumzo ya kampasi ili wanafunzi waweze kuwasiliana na kujadiliana. Jukwaa liwe na kipengele cha 'discussion forum' kinachowaruhusu wanafunzi kuchapisha bila kutaja majina, kujibu machapisho na kushiriki katika majadiliano. Wanafunzi waweze kuvinjari na kutafuta machapisho, kufuatilia mada wanazopenda na kupokea arifa. Jukwaa lihakikishe faragha na usalama wa watumiaji, likilinda taarifa binafsi za wanafunzi. Weka mandhari yenye 'honeydew' (nyeupe ya tikitimaji) kama rangi ya mandharinyuma na 'dark olive green' (kijani zeituni iliyokolea) kama rangi ya vipengele. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe ninayotoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na yatumike hasa jinsi yalivyoandikwa.

Kila ingizo la foleni linaonyesha chapisho, alama yake halisi, na ripoti zake pamoja na sababu, pamoja na vitendo viwili: 'Restore' (huondoa ripoti, kila kitu kinarudi kawaida) na 'Remove' (chapisho linatoweka kwenye mlisho na kutua kwenye 'Removed log'). Ili kutuanzisha, weka chapisho moja zaidi — 'Selling my old exam answers for Chem 110' (#academics, 2 juu / 5 chini, Day 5, majibu 0), likiwa hasa kwenye -3 — na uweke ripoti mbili za 'other' kwenye chapisho la mabaki ya mwenzake wa chumba ili foleni isiwe tupu.

target_app_summary: The anonymous campus forum grows into a full campus community platform. Discovery gets serious: an up/down voting system with net scores and tie-aware Top/New sorting feeds a windowed Trending tab, a multi-criteria screener with saved presets, and a publishable Campus Digest that snapshots trending posts and marketplace deals into frozen editions. Community tooling arrives via attachable opinion polls with live one-decimal percentage bars, per-thread emoji personas with an optional identity-reveal signature, and a report-driven Moderation Queue whose auto-flagging fires off vote-score thresholds. A three-step Marketplace adds practical campus utility with validated listings, category badges and price sorting. A final design pass unifies feed, Trending, Marketplace and Moderation Queue under one pill-badge, accent-stripe, signed-score visual language. The graph runs deep: voting (T2) powers Trending (T4), the screener (T6) and moderation auto-flagging (T7), while the Digest (T9) aggregates Trending and Marketplace output — a 3-deep chain T1-T2-T4-T9.

global_rules.rule: Net vote scores are always displayed with an explicit + sign when positive (e.g. +22), a plain 0 at zero, and a minus when negative — on every surface, including features added later.
Every topic or category label anywhere in the app is rendered lowercase with a leading # (e.g. #housing, #electronics) — app-wide, now and for anything added later.
Every count in the app is correctly pluralized ('1 vote' / '2 votes', '1 match', '1 report') — never '1 votes' — everywhere, forever.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya maswali na majibu inayojibu maswali yanayotumwa na watumiaji. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kutuma maswali, kujibu maswali na kuona majibu. follow_ups.instruction: Orodha ya ukurasa wa mwanzo inapaswa kuwa uzoefu halisi wa kuvinjari. Futa maswali yote ya mfano na uweke haya saba hasa, nitaongeza mengine baadaye: 'How do I keep sourdough starter alive?' (#cooking, +8, majibu 3), 'Best budget airlines in Europe?' (#travel, +5, majibu 2), 'Why is my laptop fan always loud?' (#tech, +5, majibu 4), 'Is intermittent fasting safe for beginners?' (#fitness, +12, jibu 1), 'How to fix a wobbly bike wheel?' (#fitness, 0, bado hakuna majibu), 'What's the best way to learn Python?' (#tech, +8, bado hakuna majibu), na 'Can I freeze fresh basil?' (#cooking, -2, jibu 1). Juu ya orodha nipe vidonge vya lebo vinavyoweza kuwashwa na kuzimwa (nikichagua kadhaa, swali linalolingana na lolote kati yake linahesabiwa), chaguo la 'answered' / 'unanswered' linalofanya kazi pamoja na lebo, kisomo cha 'Showing X of Y questions' ambacho hakidanganyi kamwe, na upangaji kwa alama, kubwa zaidi kwanza — maswali mawili yakiwa na alama sawa, lile lenye majibu mengi zaidi linakaa juu. Mambo mawili ya mtindo ninayotaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachojenga baadaye: alama daima zinaonyeshwa na ishara yake (+8, -2, na 0 tupu kwa sifuri tu), na lebo daima zinaonekana kama vidonge vya herufi ndogo vyenye # mbele.

follow_ups.instruction: Badilisha fomu ya kuuliza iwe kitunga swali cha kweli. Ninapoandika kichwa, onyesha mapendekezo ya papo hapo ya maswali yaliyopo ambayo vichwa vyake vina kile nilichoandika — bila kujali herufi kubwa au ndogo, usianze kupendekeza mpaka niwe nimeandika angalau herufi 3, na kila linalolingana lionekane pamoja na kidonge chake cha lebo na alama yake. Kagua wakati ninaandika, si wakati wa kutuma tu: kichwa kiwe na herufi kati ya 15 na 120 pamoja na kihesabu cha herufi cha papo hapo, lazima kiishie na alama ya kuuliza, lebo moja hasa iwe imechaguliwa, na kitufe cha kuchapisha kibaki kimefungwa pamoja na sababu iliyo wazi mpaka kila kitu kiwe sawa. Jambo moja zaidi kwa programu nzima kuanzia sasa: swali lolote lenye majibu sifuri lipate beji ndogo ya rangi ya 'amber' (rangi ya kaharabu) yenye maneno 'Needs answer' popote linapoonekana.

target_app_summary: The base beige-and-saddle-brown Q&A site grows into a full community knowledge platform. A pinned seven-question seed powers a tag screener with boolean tag/status filtering and tie-aware score sorting; an ask composer adds live duplicate detection and strict validation; an accept-answer workflow introduces a Solved state that propagates into the screener, a Topics analytics hub, and a capstone Triage dashboard. A points-based bounty system feeds a Featured strip, the follow-and-digest builder, and the Triage urgency ranking, while an edit-suggestion review queue adds moderation whose pending count also lands on Triage. A site-wide restyle pass locks visual consistency across the screener, Topics, Review, and Digest pages. The graph runs several chains three-plus deep (base list -> screener -> bounties -> triage; base answers -> accept workflow -> topics/triage), so early breakage compounds.

global_rules.rule: Scores always display with an explicit sign everywhere in the app: +8, -2, and a bare 0 only for zero.
Tags always render as lowercase pills prefixed with # everywhere they appear.
Any question with zero answers shows a small amber 'Needs answer' badge wherever it is listed, on all current and future surfaces.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza mfumo wa escrow wa sarafu za kripto kwa ajili ya miamala salama ya sarafu za kripto. Pia, kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza. Majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe niliyotoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

follow_ups.instruction: Kumbukumbu za miamala zimetawanyika mno - nijengee ukurasa kamili wa 'Trade Ledger' kwa ajili ya jukwaa zima. Ijazwe na biashara hizi nane pekee na si vinginevyo, nitaiongeza mwenyewe baadaye: TX-101 Dana alinunua 0.50000000 BTC kutoka kwa Marcus kwa $30,000.00 ('Released'); TX-102 Felix alinunua 10.00000000 ETH kutoka kwa Lena kwa $25,000.00 ('Released'); TX-103 Dana alinunua 500.00000000 SOL kutoka kwa Omar kwa $70,000.00 ('Refunded'); TX-104 Ravi alinunua 0.20000000 BTC kutoka kwa Marcus kwa $12,000.00 ('Disputed'); TX-105 Felix alinunua 5.00000000 ETH kutoka kwa Lena kwa $12,500.00 ('Released'); TX-106 Ana alinunua 150.00000000 SOL kutoka kwa Omar kwa $21,000.00 ('Released'); TX-107 Ravi alinunua 15.00000000 ETH kutoka kwa Priya kwa $37,500.00 ('In Escrow'); TX-108 Ana alinunua 0.10000000 BTC kutoka kwa Marcus kwa $6,000.00 ('Released'). Juu nipe kadi za muhtasari: moja ya 'total released volume' - biashara zenye hali ya 'Released' pekee ndizo zinazoingia kwenye namba hiyo - na moja ya kiasi cha fedha 'locked in escrow' kwa sasa, ukikumbuka kuwa fedha zenye hali ya 'Disputed' bado zimekaa kwenye escrow kwa hiyo nazo zinahesabika kuwa zimefungwa. Chini yake, 'per-seller breakdown' unaoonyesha thamani iliyoachiliwa ya kila muuzaji, na biashara yoyote mpya anayofanya mtu kupitia mtiririko wa kununua ionekane kwenye leja yenyewe. Kanuni ya nyumbani kuanzia sasa: kila hali kwenye programu hii, kwenye ukurasa huu na kwenye chochote tutakachojenga baadaye, iwe beji ndogo ya kidonge - 'amber' (kaharabu) kwa 'In Escrow', 'green' (kijani) kwa 'Released', 'gray' (kijivu) kwa 'Refunded', na 'dark red' (nyekundu iliyokolea) kwa 'Disputed'.

follow_ups.instruction: Wauzaji wananisumbua kila siku kuhusu kulipwa kwa kweli, kwa hiyo jenga 'Payout Center'. Kina kichaguzi cha muuzaji: nachagua muuzaji na kuona 'lifetime earned' yake - kwa kila biashara yake yenye hali ya 'Released' kwenye leja, kiasi ghafi ukiondoa ada yetu ya upande wa muuzaji ya 0.75% kutoka kwenye ratiba ya ada, huku biashara za 'Refunded', 'Disputed' na 'In Escrow' zikichangia sifuri - pamoja na kile kinachosubiri au kilicholipwa tayari, na kiasi kinachopatikana sasa hivi. Kutoka hapo muuzaji anaomba kutoa fedha kwa kuandika kiasi: kataa chochote kinachozidi 'available balance' na chochote chini ya $250, na mara ombi linapopita liweke zuio kwenye fedha hizo ili kinachopatikana kipungue papo hapo. Na kanuni ya nyumbani kuanzia sasa: kitu chochote mahali popote kwenye programu hii kinachohamisha au kuachilia fedha lazima kinioneshe uthibitisho wenye kiasi kamili cha dola kabla hakijatokea - hiyo inahusu pia kila kitu tutakachoongeza baadaye.

follow_ups.instruction: Wanunuzi wanaendelea kuniambia bei zinazoombwa kwenye kichujio ziko karibu lakini si sahihi kabisa, kwa hiyo waache wapatane bei. target_app_summary: The base crypto escrow marketplace has grown into a full P2P trading platform. It gained a live fee-and-payout calculator, a platform-wide Trade Ledger with released/locked rollups seeded with eight pinned trades, a seller Payout Center with fee-netted lifetime earnings and a hold-then-approve withdrawal queue, a seller reputation leaderboard with refund penalties and volume tiebreaks, a sandboxed practice mode with a mock wallet and its own seeded practice listings, a multi-criteria offer screener with saved presets and a reputation filter, a per-keystroke counter-offer negotiation console that re-prices screener offers, a brand restyle across five pages, and copyable seller statements that reconcile ledger records against the fee schedule and the Payout Center. The ledger (T3) is the hub: payout balances and reputation scores are computed from it, practice mode must leave it untouched, and statements are generated from it; the fee schedule (T2) feeds the Payout Center, the negotiation console, and the statements; reputation chains into the screener and the screener into the negotiation console, giving deep chains like T1->T3->T5->T7->T8 and T1->T3->T4->T10.

global_rules.rule: Crypto amounts are always shown to exactly 8 decimal places with the ticker after the number (e.g. 0.16666667 BTC), and dollar figures always as $1,234.56 with commas and two decimals.
Every trade status is a color-coded pill badge everywhere: amber In Escrow, green Released, gray Refunded, dark red Disputed.
Any action that moves or releases funds shows a confirmation with the exact dollar amounts before it completes.

Ukurasa wa kuvinjari tayari unatafuta na kuchuja, kwa hiyo usiguse chochote kati ya hayo — ninachotaka kiongezwe juu yake ni 'fit ranker': chipu za mapendeleo zinazobonyezwa kwa zile lebo nne, pamoja na 'budget box' ya kila usiku ambamo naweza kuandika, na badala ya kuficha chochote, kila tangazo libaki kwenye skrini likiwa na alama ya papo hapo — pointi 2 kwa kila chipu iliyochaguliwa ambayo linayo, pamoja na pointi 1 ikiwa bei yake ni sawa au chini ya bajeti iliyoandikwa — ikionyeshwa kwenye kadi yake kama 'Fit 3/5', ambapo kigawanyo ni alama bora zaidi inayowezekana kwa wakati huo (2 kwa kila chipu iliyochaguliwa, pamoja na 1 kila bajeti inapowekwa). target_app_summary: What began as a simple linen-and-maroon apartment rental site has grown into a full short-stay platform. Discovery grew a chip-scored fit ranker over a pinned seven-apartment catalog, a heart-saved shortlist with date-priced comparison, and a flexible-stay finder that searches for open stretches of nights; money runs through a live trip cost estimator whose fee math feeds both the shortlist compare and a multi-stop trip planner with an on-screen copyable itinerary. Operations gained an Instant Book vs request-approval pipeline with a host inbox, whose confirmed stays drive per-listing availability calendars, neighborhood insight rollups, and the finder's gap search. A warm restyle unified pill buttons, serif headings, and outlined status pills across every surface. The feature graph runs deep: base booking flow into the request pipeline into availability calendars into the trip planner and stay finder, alongside fit ranker into shortlist into planner.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya kampuni ya ushauri inayotoa mafunzo ya uongozi na biashara. follow_ups.instruction: Orodha ile bapa ya 'Workshops' haitoshi tena — nitengenezee ukurasa halisi wa 'program finder' kwa mafunzo yetu yote. Kuwe na visanduku vya kuteua kategoria za mada ('Leadership', 'Communication', 'Conflict', 'Coaching'), kichujio cha muundo cha 'Live'/'On-Demand', na kisanduku cha 'max-price' ambamo ninaandika namba; kuteua kategoria kadhaa kupanue kichujio hicho kimoja tu, huku muundo na bei vikiendelea kupunguza matokeo, na hesabu ya matokeo ionekane papo hapo kando ya orodha, na ujumbe wa kirafiki pale hakuna kinacholingana, na kila kadi ihitaji kitufe cha 'add-to-cart' ili watu wanunue moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kitafuta kupitia kikapu chetu kilichopo. Anza kwa kupakia hizi nane haswa — 'Foundations of Leadership' (Leadership, $240, 6 hrs, Live, kwa Managers, kiwango 4.8), 'Difficult Conversations' (Communication, $180, 4 hrs, Live, Managers, 4.6), 'Conflict Resolution Essentials' (Conflict, $180, 5 hrs, On-Demand, Individuals, 4.6), 'Executive Presence' (Leadership, $320, 8 hrs, Live, Executives, 4.9), 'Coaching for Performance' (Coaching, $260, 6 hrs, On-Demand, Managers, 4.7), 'Strategic Decision Making' (Leadership, $300, 6 hrs, On-Demand, Executives, 4.8), 'Team Communication Basics' (Communication, $150, 3 hrs, On-Demand, Individuals, 4.4), na 'Managing Remote Teams' (Leadership, $210, 5 hrs, Live, Managers, 4.5) — nitaongeza nyingine baadaye. Tabia moja kwa programu hii yote, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachojenga baadaye: muda daima uandikwe kama '6 hrs', kamwe si dakika.

target_app_summary: The consulting site grows from a brochure-with-cart into a full training platform. Discovery gets a multi-criteria program finder over a pinned catalog of eight programs (wired into the existing cart) and a live-scoring role/topic matcher. Commerce and planning gain a team-quote estimator with tiered volume discounts and a learning-path builder whose saved paths feed a progress-and-certificates layer. Community arrives via a live Q&A session registration flow with capacity and waitlists, and everything rolls up into a My Learning dashboard that reconciles path hours, completed hours, registrations, and certificates. A site-wide design refresh and a fixed-rate multi-currency layer cut across the finder, estimator, paths, and the original services pages. The graph's spine is finder -> path builder -> progress -> dashboard, with the estimator, sessions, matcher, restyle, and currency features hanging off it.

follow_ups.instruction: Ukurasa wa kuvinjari unazidi kujaa — nijengee 'screener' ya kweli kwa katalogi. Anza na bidhaa hizi saba haswa, nitaziongeza baadaye: 1968 Rolex Submariner ('Collectibles', zabuni ya sasa $4,200.00, +5.25% kipindi hiki, zabuni 12, muuzaji Harbor Trade Co, 'Open', inafungwa Julai 21), 10oz Silver Bullion Bar ('Metals', $310.00, -1.10%, zabuni 4, MetalWorks, 'Open', inafungwa Julai 18), Signed First-Edition Dune ('Collectibles', $850.00, +5.25%, zabuni 7, PageTurners, 'Open', inafungwa Julai 25), Antique Oak Writing Desk ('Furniture', $1,150.00, -0.40%, zabuni 9, Harbor Trade Co, 'Closing', inafungwa Julai 17), Gold Krugerrand Coin ('Metals', $2,050.00, +2.75%, zabuni 15, MetalWorks, 'Open', inafungwa Julai 30), Persian Heriz Rug ('Furniture', $980.00, -3.60%, zabuni 2, Attic Finds, 'Open', inafungwa Julai 22), na 1974 Fender Stratocaster ('Collectibles', $3,300.00, +6.40%, zabuni 21, Attic Finds, tayari ni 'Settled'). Nataka visanduku vya kuteua kategoria ambapo kuteua viwili maana yake ni onyesha chochote kati ya hivyo, visanduku vya bei ya chini na ya juu vinavyoandikwa, na kiteuzi cha hali, vyote vikipunguza matokeo kwa pamoja, kihesabu hai cha vinavyolingana ambacho daima kinakubaliana na kilicho kwenye skrini, na njia ya kuhifadhi mchanganyiko wa vichujio kwa jina na kuupakia tena baadaye. Mambo mawili ninayoyajali kila mahali katika programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: mabadiliko ya kipindi daima yanaonyeshwa na alama na desimali mbili kama +5.25% au -1.10%, na hali ya bidhaa daima inaonyeshwa kama kitufe cha rangi — kijani kwa 'Open', kaharabu kwa 'Closing', kijivu kwa 'Settled'.

follow_ups.instruction: Kuweka zabuni kunahisi kama sanduku jeusi — ipe kila bidhaa 'bid ticket' ya kweli. Tabia nyingine ninayoitaka kila mahali katika programu hii kuanzia sasa, kwa kitu chochote kinachotumia pesa au kisichoweza kutenduliwa: nionyeshe muhtasari wa kuthibitisha kabla haijatekelezwa, kuanzia na tikiti hii, ambayo zabuni zake zilizothibitishwa zinaingia katika 'trading history' yangu kama kawaida. target_app_summary: The little lemon-chiffon bidding site has grown into a full auction-trading platform. Discovery got serious: a multi-criteria screener with saved presets over a pinned seven-lot catalog, a starred watchlist with live value rollups, a Market Movers panel with tie-aware rankings, and a July 2026 close-date calendar that cross-filters by category and watchlist. Trading mechanics deepened: a live bid ticket computes tiered increments and fee-inclusive totals per keystroke, and a close-and-settle workflow turns Closing lots into searchable Completed Sales records using the same fee schedule. Community and context layers sit on top — seller profiles with half-up-rounded ratings and a tie-broken leaderboard gated on settled sales, and per-listing price-history charts with windowed high/low stats — before a final chocolate-pill restyle sweeps every surface. The feature graph runs one deep chain (bid ticket -> settlement -> reputation) alongside a discovery cluster (screener -> watchlist -> calendar) and movers fed by ticket activity.

global_rules.rule: Session change percentages always display signed with exactly two decimals (e.g. +5.25%, -1.10%) on every surface.
Listing status always renders as a colored pill badge — green Open, amber Closing, gray Settled — wherever a listing appears.
Any money-committing or irreversible action (bids, settlements) always shows a confirmation summary before executing.
