follow_ups.instruction: Napenda mwelekeo huu. Sasa nataka ukurasa uitwao 'Delivery Log' unaorekodi kiotomatiki kila barua pepe ambayo jukwaa hutuma, mpya zaidi juu, na kila safu ikionyesha mpokeaji, mada, hali, mara ngapi ilifunguliwa na ilitoka lini. Nipe kichujio cha hali na kisanduku cha utafutaji kwa mpokeaji na mada vinavyofanya kazi pamoja — vyote viwili vitumike kwa wakati mmoja, si kimoja au kingine. Onyesha hali kama vibandiko vidogo vyenye rangi — kijani kwa 'delivered', manjano-kahawia kwa 'bounced', nyekundu kwa 'failed' — na tumia mpangilio huohuo wa rangi kila mahali hali inapoonekana katika programu hii, sasa na katika chochote tutakachojenga baadaye. Jaza kumbukumbu mapema kwa hizi saba haswa, nitaongeza zaidi nikiendelea: dev@nova.io 'February promo' delivered ikiwa na kufunguliwa 3 tarehe 3 Januari 2025 4:45 PM; ben@acme.com 'Invoice #204' delivered ikiwa na kufunguliwa 0 tarehe 4 Januari 2025 2:02 PM; cara@nova.io 'Welcome aboard' bounced ikiwa na kufunguliwa 0 tarehe 5 Januari 2025 10:30 AM; ana@acme.com 'Welcome aboard' delivered ikiwa na kufunguliwa 3 tarehe 6 Januari 2025 9:15 AM; eli@orbit.dev 'Invoice #205' failed ikiwa na kufunguliwa 0 tarehe 7 Januari 2025 8:20 AM; fay@orbit.dev 'February promo' delivered ikiwa na kufunguliwa 1 tarehe 8 Januari 2025 11:05 AM; na gus@acme.com 'Welcome aboard' delivered ikiwa na kufunguliwa 2 tarehe 9 Januari 2025 1:40 PM. Chochote nitakachotuma kipya kutoka ukurasa wa kuandika pia kiingie hapa, kikiwa 'delivered' na kufunguliwa 0.

follow_ups.instruction: Mara kwa mara natuma barua pepe kimakosa kwa watu ambao barua zao ziliishia kuwa 'bounced', kwa hivyo nipe ukurasa uitwao 'Blocklist'. Nikiandika anwani, uthibitishe muundo wake papo hapo ninapoandika — uonyeshe takataka kabla hata sijabonyeza kitufe cha kuongeza — na ukatae marudio bila kujali herufi kubwa au ndogo, BEN@ACME.COM na ben@acme.com ni mtu yuleyule. Weka orodha kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti na uianzishe na cara@nova.io na spam-trap@bait.org. Na ukiwa hapo: kila mahali katika programu hii, sasa na katika chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye, onyesha anwani za barua pepe kwa herufi ndogo bila kujali nilivyoziandika. Na ukurasa wa kuandika lazima uheshimu orodha kweli kweli — nikijaribu kutuma kwa mtu aliyemo, simamisha utumaji na uniambie hapohapo ni anwani ipi imezuiwa, na kisitoke chochote wala kisionekane kama kilichotumwa.

Nataka 'total emails', mchanganuo wa 'delivered'/'bounced'/'failed' pamoja na chati rahisi ya pau, jumla ya kufunguliwa, 'open rate' na 'bounce rate' — 'open rate' ikimaanisha sehemu ya barua pepe zilizofikishwa ambazo zilifunguliwa angalau mara moja (zile za 'bounced' na 'failed' haziingii kwenye kigawanyo hicho), na 'bounce rate' ni marudisho kati ya zote. target_app_summary: The base email composer has grown into a full email-operations suite. Around the original compose/send/templates core, it gained a seeded Delivery Log with status badges and combined status+search filtering, a Blocklist that live-validates and gates every send, an Analytics page computing open/bounce rates and a tie-broken opens leaderboard from the log, a Scheduled-send Outbox with a pinned platform clock that dispatches into the log, a per-keystroke personalization preview that pulls sample recipients from the log, an A/B subject-test wizard whose audience is the deduped log minus the blocklist, a segment builder computing saved audiences from log engagement minus the blocklist that feeds compose, a full design restyle across all surfaces, and a live copyable account Digest that reconciles the log, analytics, blocklist, outbox, and segments. The feature graph funnels through the Delivery Log (five consumers) and the Blocklist (three consumers), with the deepest chain running compose -> log -> analytics -> digest.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya ufuatiliaji wa mnyororo wa ugavi kwa ajili ya kufuatilia na kuthibitisha asili na mzunguko wa bidhaa kwa kutumia vitambulisho vya kipekee vya bidhaa. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa usajili wa bidhaa, ufuatiliaji, uulizaji na uthibitisho. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana kwenye tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza. target_app_summary: The base traceability site (register products, track circulation, inquire status, verify authenticity, view stats) grows into a full supply-chain integrity platform. Operations gains lot-level grouping with rolled-up lot statuses, a validating bulk event importer that feeds product journeys, and a lot-scoped recall workflow with retrieval progress and auto-close. Anti-counterfeit tooling adds a scan monitor that logs every verification check and flags 7-day scan bursts against a typed threshold, plus a counterfeit report intake and investigation queue that uses the scan log as evidence and can flip products (and their lots) to Flagged. Discovery and quality surfaces add a multi-criteria registry screener with any-of status logic, presets and an on-page text export, a chain integrity audit that sweeps every journey for custody gaps (skipped shipping legs, activity after delivery) and ranks lots by issue count with clean badges, and a checkpoint analytics page that dedups products per location and ranks with alphabetical tie-breaks. A mid-ladder restyle unifies five surfaces under one firebrick-on-misty-rose skin. The graph runs deep: lots feed recalls and every lot-grouped rollup, and the importer feeds lot rollups, the integrity audit, and checkpoint analytics.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza mfumo wa serikali mtandao kwa ajili ya usimamizi wa ofisi, 'infrastructure management', 'procurement management', 'personnel management', 'financial management' na usimamizi wa 'decision-making'. Mfumo unapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa usimamizi wa ofisi, 'infrastructure management', 'procurement management', 'personnel management', 'financial management' na usimamizi wa 'decision-making'. Watumiaji waweze kuvinjari taarifa husika, kuwasilisha maombi, kuidhinisha, kuuliza hali ya maombi na kufanya shughuli zinazohusiana. Mfumo pia uwe na huduma kama 'leave', kuondoka kwa maafisa wa ngazi ya kati kutoka Shenzhen, mahudhurio na usimamizi wa 'mamlaka matano', ambazo ziweze kubuni fomu na michakato husika na kuzisambaza. Tumia 'light pink' (waridi hafifu) kwa mandharinyuma ya ukurasa na 'medium violet red' (nyekundu-zambarau ya wastani) kwa vipengele. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe niliyotoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

follow_ups.instruction: Upande wa manunuzi sasa unahitaji nguvu za kweli. Nipe ukurasa wa 'budget lines' chini ya 'financial management' na 'requisition builder' cha kweli ndani ya manunuzi: nachagua kipengele cha bajeti, naandika maelezo ya bidhaa, idadi na bei ya kipimo kimoja, na ninapoandika kionyeshe papo hapo jumla, salio la kipengele hicho, na ngazi ya idhini itakayohusika — chini ya $5,000 huenda kwa 'Department Head', kuanzia $5,000 hadi $25,000 bila kukijumuisha huenda kwa 'Finance Director', na $25,000 au zaidi huenda kwa 'City Council'. Jumla yangu ikizidi salio la kipengele, tarakimu ya salio igeuke nyekundu na onyo, ikisasishwa kila ninapobonyeza kitufe, si wakati wa kuwasilisha tu. Anza 'budget lines' na hivi sita hasa, vikiingizwa kwa mpangilio huu hasa kwa sababu nitaongeza orodha baadaye: 'Vehicle Fleet' (Manunuzi) $45,000 imetengwa / $31,500 imetumika; 'Roads & Bridges' (Miundombinu) $120,000 / $84,000; 'Office Supplies' (Ofisi) $15,000 / $9,200; 'IT Equipment' (Ofisi) $60,000 / $58,500; 'Staff Training' (Wafanyakazi) $25,000 / $11,000; 'Public Parks' (Miundombinu) $80,000 / $80,000. Ninapowasilisha, ombi lipate kumbukumbu kama REQ-001, REQ-002 zikipanda mfululizo — na nataka mtindo huo huo hasa (kiambishi chake cha herufi, tarakimu tatu, zikipanda) kwa kitu chochote kinachoweza kuwasilishwa tutakachoongeza kwenye programu hii — pamoja na kibonye cha hali 'Pending' cha rangi ya kaharabu; kwa kweli, weka kaharabu-'Pending', kijani-'Approved', nyekundu-'Rejected' kuwa rangi za beji kila mahali, sasa na kwa chochote kitakachokuja baadaye.

target_app_summary: The base e-government portal grows into a full municipal resource-planning suite centered on a live budget-lines ledger. Procurement gains a keystroke-live requisition builder with budget validation and approval tiers, plus a supplier-facing vendor portal with quote tie-breaking and awards. Finance gains a travel-and-expense approval workflow that posts approved spending onto the ledger, a grants module with over-spend guards, and a what-if scenario planner that clones live spending. Decision-making gains a utilization/variance report with tie-aware ranking and rounding-sensitive rollups, a KPI dashboard whose statuses are computed against budget-line utilization, and a council decision-packet workflow that compiles the report, the KPI tallies, and council-tier procurement items into a reviewable, approvable brief. The feature graph runs a deep spine (budget lines -> expense posting -> utilization report -> decision packets) with the planner, KPI dashboard, and vendor portal branching off the same spine, and a mid-ladder restyle sweeping every surface.

global_rules.rule: Every submitted/created record gets a type-prefixed sequential reference: its own letter prefix plus a three-digit counter (REQ-001, EXP-001, BID-001, ...), counting up per type, for every submittable thing in the app now and later.
Every status badge app-wide is a colored pill: amber for Pending, green for Approved, red for Rejected — on every surface, now and for anything added later.
Any rejection anywhere in the app requires the approver to type a reason, and that reason is displayed on the rejected record.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza mfumo wa mahudhurio ya muda kwa ajili ya kurekodi mahudhurio ya wafanyakazi. Mfumo uwe na uwezo wa mfanyakazi kufanya 'clock in' na 'clock out', na wa kuangalia 'attendance records'. Wafanyakazi waweze kufanya 'clock in' na 'clock out', na waweze kuona 'attendance records' zao wenyewe, ikiwa ni pamoja na 'attendance time' na 'absence time'. Wasimamizi waweze kuona 'attendance records' za wafanyakazi wote, na kufanya takwimu na uchambuzi. Weka 'papaya whip' (nyeupe ya papai) kama rangi ya msingi na 'dark orange' (chungwa iliyokolea) kwa vipengele vyote. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana kwenye tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza. Majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe yaliyotolewa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

target_app_summary: The base time-attendance app grows into a full workforce operations suite for a small company. A pinned six-person roster with an exact seeded week of hours (Mar 2-7, 2026) feeds a ranked weekly rollup, an overtime/exceptions board, a live pay-stub calculator, a filterable payroll report with on-screen export, and a schedule-adherence scoreboard. Around that analytics core sit workflows and tools: a PIN kiosk that punches straight into timesheets, a PTO/leave center with request-approve-deduct mechanics, and a punch-correction queue whose approvals rewrite timesheet days and cascade through the rollup and overtime flags. The graph runs deep: roster/timesheets (T2) feed overtime (T4) which feeds payroll (T6) and correction propagation (T8), while leave (T5) feeds both the report export (T7) and adherence scoring (T9); a final restyle (T10) sweeps six surfaces. App-wide conventions - 'Xh Ym' durations, 'Mon, Mar 2' dates, and confirm-before-approve/reject - are introduced early and silently enforced on every later surface.

edges.what: rolls up the base app's attendance records
kiosk punches toggle the base clock-in/out status
PINs resolve against the seeded roster; punches land in timesheets
overtime computed over the seeded week's timesheets
PTO balances start from the roster's seeded allowances
wages and weekly hours from roster/timesheets
regular/overtime hour split from the overtime classification
report rows built from timesheet weekly hours
approved (never pending) leave lines in the export
approved corrections rewrite timesheet days and re-rank the rollup
approved corrections re-trigger overtime flags
adherence compares schedule against timesheet punches
approved leave counts as covered days in the score
restyles the base dashboard
restyles the weekly rollup
restyles the kiosk
restyles the overtime board
restyles the leave center
restyles the pay calculator

global_rules.rule: Durations are always displayed as hours and minutes like '7h 30m' - never decimal hours - everywhere in the app, now and for anything added later.
Dates are always written weekday-first like 'Mon, Mar 2' everywhere in the app from turn 4 onward.
Any approve or reject action anywhere in the app asks for confirmation before it goes through.

target_app_summary: The single-form women's health survey site grows into a small research-program platform. Discovery and intake expand into a sectioned survey wizard with conditional questions and a demo fill, plus a standalone wellness self-check calculator that nudges high-stress and low-sleep users toward taking the full survey. On the analysis side, a cohort screener with AND/OR demographic filtering becomes the hub: an insights strip cross-filters live stats over it, an export composer renders copyable extracts of the filtered set, and a flag-based follow-up queue with Pending/Contacted/Resolved adjudication feeds a Program Outcomes report that rolls up a resolution rate and a reached-stage outcome funnel, with suggested flags scanned from the cohort. A question bank with per-question versioning governs the wizard's wording, and a site-wide restyle unifies buttons, headings, cards, ID chips and tables across all surfaces. The graph hangs off the screener (T2) with a deep chain T1 -> T2 -> T6 -> T10 (T2 also feeding T10's suggested flags), wizard chains T2 -> T4 -> T9, and a calculator nudge T1 -> T3.

global_rules.rule: Respondents are always referred to by IDs in the WHS-#### style (WHS- prefix plus number) everywhere in the app, now and in anything added later.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya kuajiri madereva na kutangaza nafasi za kazi. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kujisajili kwa watumiaji, kutangaza kazi, kuomba kazi, na fomu ya mawasiliano. Watumiaji waweze kujisajili na kutengeneza wasifu, kuomba kazi, na kusimamia taarifa zao za mawasiliano. Wateja waweze kuona matangazo yao ya kazi yanayoendelea. Muhimu: kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe niliyoyatoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

target_app_summary: The driver recruitment site grows from a simple job board with registration and a contact form into a full two-sided hiring platform. Drivers get a multi-criteria job screener over a pinned board of carrier listings, a live pay calculator that saves a personal pay target, a match-score tuner that ranks every job against their preferences, and a My Applications tracker that mirrors applied state onto the job board with Applied markers and handles confirm-gated withdrawals. Clients get an applications dashboard with per-posting rollups, a status pipeline, company profile pages with rating-ranked directory and pay averages, and an interview scheduling flow with slot-conflict handling that writes back to the driver's side. A late full-site restyle unifies buttons, headings, cards, and badges across every surface. The feature graph has two deep spines: jobs-page features stack screener -> featured ranking -> company listings, and the hiring pipeline stacks the base apply flow -> application tracker -> client dashboard -> interview scheduling (4 deep), with the calculator's saved target feeding the match tuner.

global_rules.rule: Weekly pay is always written as whole dollars with a comma and a /wk suffix (e.g. $1,560/wk) everywhere in the app.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza programu-tumizi ya wavuti kwa vipindi vya ukocha vya mtu mmoja mmoja inayounganisha makocha na watumiaji. Programu inapaswa kuwa na vipengele kama 'personality assessment', wasifu wa mtumiaji, ulinganishaji wa ukocha na ushauri, upangaji wa ratiba na usimamizi wa vipindi, pamoja na kuweka malengo na kufuatilia maendeleo. Watumiaji waweze kukamilisha 'personality assessment' nzima, kuunda na kusimamia wasifu wao, kutafuta na kuchagua makocha wanaofaa, kupanga vipindi vya ukocha, na kuweka malengo na kuyafuatilia. target_app_summary: The one-to-one coaching matcher has grown into a full coaching marketplace and management suite. Discovery grew a real screener over a pinned seven-coach directory (specialty OR-checkboxes ANDed with typed price/experience caps) and a per-keystroke booking cost estimator with tiered discounts, while scheduling grew a per-keystroke block planner that lays out a whole run of proposed session dates (weekly or every-two-weeks), does honest month-boundary date math, and flags clashes against the live booking calendar. Relationship workflows grew a free intro-call request pipeline (user request -> coach inbox -> accept/decline with confirmations), post-session star ratings that feed averages, sorting and a minimum-rating filter back into the screener, and a per-coach engagement journal with an on-screen plain-text export. Planning grew milestone-based goal tracking with a milestone-weighted overall rollup, and everything converges on a coaching hub whose tiles (upcoming sessions, pending intro requests, unrated sessions) stay in lockstep with the underlying pages. A final visual system pass unifies buttons, cards, rating colors, and status chips across all surfaces. The graph runs two deep chains — directory -> trial requests -> hub, and directory -> ratings -> journal — so early breakage compounds.

global_rules.rule: Any coach rate shown anywhere is spelled out like '$120 per session', never a bare number.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya mchezo wa kuchakata taka kwa watoto ili kuwafundisha watoto jinsi ya kuchakata taka kwa usahihi. Mchezo unapaswa kuwa na vipengele vya ushindani kama vile 'leaderboard' ili kuwafanya watoto waendelee kushiriki na kuhamasika. Mchezo unapaswa kutumia muundo wa picha wa mtindo wa katuni ili uvutie macho ya watoto. Watoto waweze kucheza mchezo, kupata maoni ya papo hapo, kujifunza jinsi ya kupanga taka kwa usahihi kwenye vyombo vinavyolingana, na kupata zawadi na kutambuliwa kupitia mchezo. Tumia seashell (nyeupe ya kombe) kwa mandharinyuma ya vyombo na crimson (nyekundu iliyokolea) kwa mwonekano wa vipengele. Muhimu: kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa KIINGEREZA; majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe ninayotoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

follow_ups.instruction: Wazazi waliomba kuona maendeleo, kwa hiyo jenga ukurasa wa 'My Journey': kila mchezo unaomalizika unaandikwa hapo kama raundi, na anzisha historia kwa hizi sita hasa, kutoka ya zamani hadi mpya — 'Park Patrol' 180 pts (9 kati ya 12 zilipangwa sawa, nyota 4), 'Kitchen Cleanup' 260 pts (13 kati ya 15, nyota 6), 'Park Patrol' 140 pts (6 kati ya 10, nyota 3), 'Kitchen Cleanup' 260 pts (14 kati ya 15, nyota 7), 'Park Patrol' 220 pts (11 kati ya 12, nyota 5), 'Park Patrol' 90 pts (5 kati ya 8, nyota 2) — nitaongeza nyingine kwa kucheza tu. Onyesha raundi kuanzia mpya hadi ya zamani, pamoja na 'all-time average' ya alama ikionyeshwa kwa desimali moja, namba ya 'recent form' inayochukua wastani wa raundi tatu za mwisho pekee, 'overall accuracy' iliyohesabiwa kutoka jumla ya majibu sahihi kati ya jumla ya vitu (desimali moja), 'total stars banked', na 'best-round spotlight' ambapo alama zikilingana raundi yenye usahihi zaidi ndiyo inashinda. Kuanzia sasa, katika programu nzima na katika chochote tutakachojenga baadaye, alama zisomeke daima zikiwa na 'pts' baada ya namba, kama 260 pts. Pia fanya mchezo wenyewe uwe rahisi kugusa — gusa kitu kisha gusa pipa ili kukipanga — na wape watoto kitufe kikubwa cha 'Done for now' kinachomaliza raundi mapema na bado kinaiandika kwenye safari.

follow_ups.instruction: Sasa jambo kubwa: geuza mchezo kuwa ramani ya 'Recycle City' yenye sehemu nne — 'Park', 'Kitchen', 'School', 'Factory' — kila moja na rundo lake lenye mada yake ('School' inapata vitu kama 'crumpled paper', 'juice boxes' na 'broken crayons'; 'Kitchen' inapata maganda ya ndizi, mitungi ya kioo na madumu ya maziwa). 'Park' iko wazi daima, 'Kitchen' inafunguka mara raundi yoyote ya 'Park' kwenye safari inapofikia 150 pts, 'School' inafunguka mara raundi ya 'Kitchen' inapofikia 250 pts, na 'Factory' inafunguka mara raundi ya 'School' inapofikia 250 pts — amua yote hayo kutoka historia ya safari, kwa hiyo kwa raundi zangu zilizopandikizwa sehemu tatu zinapaswa kuwa tayari zimefunguka. Kugusa sehemu kunaonyesha utangulizi mdogo wenye rundo lake la vitu na kitufe cha kuanza, kucheza hapo kunaendesha mchezo uleule wa kugusa-kupanga (kikiwemo kitufe cha 'Done'), na raundi iliyomalizika inaandikwa kwenye safari ikiwa na lebo ya jina la sehemu hiyo. Ah, na kila wakati kitu chochote kwenye programu hii kikiwa kimefungwa — sasa au katika chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye — onyesha kufuli ndogo pamoja na hasa kinachohitajika ili kukifungua.

target_app_summary: The little sorting game has grown into a full kids' eco-arcade. Identity and progression came first: an Avatar Studio with validated nicknames, then a My Journey stats page that logs every finished round (seeded with six exact rounds) and computes weighted accuracy, recent-form vs all-time averages, and a tie-broken best-round spotlight. On top of the journey grew a Recycle City map whose four themed spots unlock from history scores, an Impact Calculator with a lifetime counter, a star-currency Sticker Shop, a teacher-facing Challenge Builder that draws item piles from the map and pre-fills targets from the journey, and a dedup-collectible Fact Card Album banked by spot visits. A Deep Sea Rescue restyle swept the game, map, journey and shop, and everything converges in an Eco Hero Certificate maker that renders the buddy, stars, best round, sticker count and fact completion in a live preview plus copyable text block. The graph is journey-centric: T3 feeds T4, T5, T6, T8, T9 and T10, with a four-deep chain T1-T3-T4-T9-T10.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya lango la matukio ya familia kwa ajili ya kuchapisha na kuhifadhi tanzia, mipango ya mazishi na kumbukumbu za medianuwai. Tovuti iwe na huduma za 'obituary publishing', orodha ya 'mortuaries', 'condolences' na 'statistics'. Watumiaji waweze kuchapisha na kusimamia tanzia na mipango yao ya mazishi, kuona tanzia za wengine na kuacha ujumbe juu yake, na kuona uchanganuzi wa data. Tumia cornsilk (nyeupe ya mahindi) kwa muundo wa nje na peru (kahawia ya peru) kwa vizuizi vya kiolesura. Pia, kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa KIINGEREZA; majina ya huduma, kurasa na vitufe ninayotaja katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike vilevile kama nilivyoyaandika.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the obituary publishing section and submit a new obituary with a title, content, and image.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The obituary should be successfully published, appear on the user's dashboard, and be accessible to other users from the main obituaries page.

ui_instruct.task: Look up the list of local mortuaries available on the website.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The list should display comprehensive details about each mortuary, including name, location, and contact information.

ui_instruct.task: Leave a condolence message on an existing obituary.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The message should be successfully posted under the selected obituary and visible to other users.

ui_instruct.task: Check the statistics page for the statistical analysis of obituary-related data.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The page should display clear and relevant statistics, such as the number of obituaries published, the most recent obituaries, or any trend analysis available.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate through the website using the main navigation menu.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each link in the navigation menu should lead to the appropriate section or page, and the navigation menu should remain consistent across all pages.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'cornsilk' as the background color and 'peru' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'cornsilk' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'peru', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: Familia zinaendelea kutuomba msaada wa maneno ya kuandikwa kwenye mawe na vibao vya kaburi, kwa hiyo nataka 'inscription designer': nachagua mmoja wa wakumbukwa wetu kutoka kwenye orodha naye anajaza jina la mtu pamoja na tarehe zake za kuzaliwa na za kufariki; kisha ninapoandika mstari wa 'epitaph', onyesho la uchongaji linajichora upya kwa kila mbonyezo wa kitufe, pamoja na hesabu ya papo hapo ya herufi zilizosalia — mchongaji anaweka kikomo cha herufi 40 kwa 'epitaph', kwa hiyo nikizidi ieleze wazi na ikatae kuhifadhi. Onyesho pia lionyeshe umri aliofikia mtu huyo, na umri uwe sahihi: mtu ambaye siku yake ya kuzaliwa ilikuwa bado haijafika mwaka huo ana umri wa mwaka mmoja chini ya utoaji wa kawaida. Kuhifadhi kuweke andiko lililokamilika kwenye ukurasa wa tanzia wa mtu huyo. Pia jaza kumbukumbu mapema na hawa sita hasa, nitaongeza wengine baadaye: Harold Finch, Veteran, March 12, 1932 – April 5, 2024; Rosa Delgado, Educator, July 4, 1945 – January 18, 2024; Miriam Okafor, Artist, November 30, 1958 – April 5, 2024; Walter Brandt, Veteran, February 29, 1940 – December 2, 2023; Lena Kowalski, Community Leader, September 9, 1951 – March 12, 2024; na Samuel Whitcombe, aliyekuwa Veteran na pia Educator, June 21, 1929 – February 14, 2024. Jambo moja zaidi linalohusu kila kitu katika programu hii, sasa na chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: andika tarehe kwa jina la mwezi, kama 'March 12, 1932' — sipendi kabisa 03/12/32.
follow_ups.source_feature: Headstone and plaque shopping with custom inscription preview

ui_instruct.task: In the inscription designer, pick Rosa Delgado from the memorial list and look at the preview.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The preview fills in 'Rosa Delgado' with her dates July 4, 1945 – January 18, 2024 and shows the age she reached as 78 — not 79 — because the July birthday had not yet arrived by January.

ui_instruct.task: Pick any memorial in the inscription designer and type a few characters of an epitaph while watching the preview and the character count.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The engraved preview and the remaining-character count update as each character is typed, without needing to submit or save.

ui_instruct.task: In the inscription designer, pick Harold Finch, type the epitaph 'A devoted father, grandfather, and friend to absolutely everyone' (well over 40 characters), and try to save.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The designer flags the epitaph as over the 40-character limit and refuses to save; no inscription appears on Harold Finch's obituary page.

ui_instruct.task: Pick Rosa Delgado in the inscription designer, type the epitaph 'Beloved teacher and friend', save it, then open Rosa Delgado's obituary page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The finished inscription appears on Rosa Delgado's obituary page showing 'Beloved teacher and friend', with her dates written with the month spelled out, like 'July 4, 1945'.

ui_instruct.task: Open an obituary from the main obituaries listing, type a condolence message into its message form, and submit it.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The condolence message appears under that obituary, visible with the rest of its messages.

follow_ups.instruction: Sasa kwa kuwa kumbukumbu inakua, nipe 'browse page' ya maana: kuchuja kwa makundi ('Veteran', 'Educator', 'Artist', 'Community Leader' — nikichagua kadhaa, yeyote anayelingana na lolote kati yao aonekane, na asiwepo anayejitokeza mara mbili hata kama ana lebo mbili kama Samuel), pamoja na 'birth-decade filter' kinachopunguza ndani ya makundi yaliyochaguliwa, hesabu ya wangapi wanaonyeshwa, na kidhibiti cha mpangilio chenye chaguo za alfabeti, 'newest passing first' (mpangilio halisi wa tarehe, na wawili wakiwa na tarehe moja wapangwe kwa alfabeti), na 'busiest guestbook' kwa idadi ya ujumbe wa 'condolences'. Na ninapochapisha tanzia mpya kwenye fomu ya kawaida, niruhusu kuchagua kundi lake hapo hapo, ili kumbukumbu mpya zilizochapishwa ziingie zikiwa na lebo na zionekane hapa chini ya kundi lake. Na kuanzia sasa, kila jina la mtu linapotokea mahali popote kwenye programu hii — ukurasa huu, maonyesho ya awali, na chochote kitakachokuja — weka miaka yake mara baada ya jina, kama 'Harold Finch (1932–2024)'.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Exactly 4 memorials show — Harold Finch, Walter Brandt, Samuel Whitcombe, and Rosa Delgado — with Samuel Whitcombe listed once (not duplicated for holding both tags), and the visible count reads 4.

ui_instruct.expected_result: No memorials match, and the page shows a clear no-results message instead of a blank or broken area.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The preview fills in 'Rosa Delgado' with her dates July 4, 1945 – January 18, 2024 and shows the age she reached as 78 — not 79 — because the July birthday had not yet arrived by January.

follow_ups.instruction: Napenda sana wazo la kuwakumbuka watu katika siku zao maalum. Nipe ukurasa wa 'On This Date' ambapo ninaandika mwezi na siku na papo hapo unaonyesha kila mtu ambaye 'birthday anniversary' au 'passing anniversary' yake inaangukia tarehe hiyo — ukionyesha wazi ipi ni ipi, kwa sababu March 12 ni siku ya kuzaliwa ya Harold lakini pia ndiyo siku aliyofariki Lena. February 29 lazima ifanye kazi kwa Walter, na pale hakuna anayelingana, useme hivyo kwa upole badala ya kuacha ukurasa mtupu. Chochote kipya kinachochapishwa kichukuliwe hapa pia.

follow_ups.instruction: Wageni wanaendelea kunitumia hadithi zao kwa barua pepe — waruhusu kuwasilisha kumbukumbu iliyoandikwa moja kwa moja kwenye ukurasa wa tanzia, ikiwa na saini ya jina lao. Yaliyowasilishwa yasichapishwe yenyewe: yasubiri kwenye 'pending queue' kwenye 'dashboard' yangu, ambapo naidhinisha au nakataa kila moja; kumbukumbu zilizoidhinishwa zionekane katika sehemu ya 'Tributes' kwenye ukurasa wa mtu huyo, na zilizokataliwa zipotee kabisa. Anzisha foleni ya Rosa Delgado na tatu zinazosubiri — moja kutoka Tomás Rivera, moja kutoka Grace Lin na moja kutoka Sam Porter. Pia, upendeleo wa kudumu kwa programu hii yote, sasa na baadaye: kila kitu kinapokataliwa, kuondolewa au kufutwa, niulize 'una uhakika' kabla hakijatokea.

follow_ups.instruction: Familia zinaendelea kuuliza jinsi zinavyoweza kusaidia kwenye gharama, kwa hiyo ongeza 'memorial fund' kwenye kurasa za tanzia: kiasi cha lengo, fomu ya ahadi inayopokea jina na kiasi (namba chanya tu, bila shaka), jumla iliyokusanywa inayosasishwa mara tu ahadi inapoingia, na upau wa maendeleo unaoonyesha asilimia kama namba nzima. Weka mfuko wa Harold Finch na lengo la $4,000 na ahadi zilizokwisha ingia kutoka kwa Ellen ($850), familia ya Hendersons ($325) na VFW Post 12 ($1,000); ule wa Rosa Delgado una lengo la $1,500 wenye $900 kutoka PTA na $700 kutoka Grace Lin — ndiyo, wake umeshapita lengo, kwa hiyo upau wake ukae umejaa kwa 100% huku ukiendelea kusema ukweli kuhusu jumla. Na kwenye ile 'browse page', nipe kichujio cha kuona kumbukumbu zenye 'active fund' pekee.

follow_ups.instruction: Kwa ajili ya mipango ya mazishi ninahitaji 'RSVP': anayeangalia ibada anajaza jina lake, watu wangapi wako kwenye kundi lake (namba nzima, angalau 1), na kama atahudhuria au anatuma 'regrets'. Kisha kwenye 'dashboard' yangu, onyesha 'expected headcount' ya kila ibada — ukihesabu viti vya makundi yanayohudhuria pekee — pamoja na orodha kamili ya 'RSVP' zote ikijumuisha 'regrets'. Ibada ya Harold Finch ya April 12, 2024 ianze ikiwa na 'RSVP' tatu tayari: Ellen Finch akiwa na kundi la 4, Marcus Webb akiwa na 2, na Dana Cruz anayetuma 'regrets' kwa 3.

follow_ups.instruction: Kurasa za 'guestbook' zinapaswa kuhisi kama mazungumzo — waruhusu watu kutoa 'reply' kwa ujumbe mmoja mahususi wa 'condolences', 'reply' zikionyeshwa zikiwa zimepangwa chini ya ujumbe husika, na uonyeshe 'message total' ya kila 'guestbook' ikihesabu 'reply' pia. Mpangilio ule wa 'busiest guestbook' kwenye 'browse page' nao lazima uhesabu 'reply', si ujumbe wa ngazi ya juu pekee. Rejesha ujumbe wa mfano ili 'guestbook' ya Miriam Okafor iwe na 'condolences' mbili hasa, ile ya June Park ikiwa na 'reply' tatu, na ya Harold Finch iwe na 'condolences' nne hasa bila 'reply' — yaani kitabu cha Miriam, chenye tano, ndicho chenye shughuli nyingi zaidi hata kama Harold ana ujumbe mwingi zaidi wa ngazi ya juu.

follow_ups.instruction: Baada ya kifo kuna karatasi nyingi mno za kushughulikia — tengeneza eneo la 'checklist' ya familia: kazi zenye kundi ('Paperwork', 'Notifications' au 'Household'), mtu aliyepewa jukumu (Ellen, Marcus au Priya), kisanduku cha imekamilika, na uwezo wa kuongeza au kuondoa kazi; kisha muhtasari kwenye 'dashboard' unaoonyesha idadi na asilimia ya kazi zilizokamilika kwa kila mtu pamoja na asilimia ya jumla, kwa namba nzima, nusu ikipandishwa juu. Anza na hizi nane: Ellen ana 'File the death certificate' ('Paperwork', imekamilika), 'Order memorial cards' ('Household', imekamilika) na 'Close the safe-deposit box' ('Paperwork', bado); Marcus ana 'Notify the pension office' ('Notifications', imekamilika), 'Cancel the newspaper' ('Notifications', bado) na 'Return the wheelchair rental' ('Household', bado); Priya ana 'Write thank-you notes' ('Household', bado) na 'Notify the alumni association' ('Notifications', bado).

follow_ups.instruction: Ni wakati wa sura mpya, na lazima ifike kila mahali, si ukurasa wa mwanzo pekee: vitufe vikuu vya hatua — kuhifadhi katika 'inscription designer', kuahidi kwenye mifuko, 'RSVP' kwenye ibada, kuidhinisha kwenye foleni ya 'dashboard' — vibadilike kutoka peru kwenda forest green (kijani cha msitu); kichwa kikuu cha kila ukurasa kiwe katikati; lebo za makundi ziwe vidonge vidogo vyenye mandharinyuma ya wheat (ngano) na maandishi ya kahawia iliyokolea; kadi za wakumbukwa na za ibada zipate pembe zilizoviringishwa kwa upole; na majina ya marehemu yawe katika fonti ya serif popote yanapotokea. Tafadhali hakikisha kuwa 'browse archive', 'inscription designer', kurasa za mifuko, kurasa za ibada na 'RSVP', na 'dashboard' — vyote vinapata mabadiliko haya kweli — bila kurasa zilizofanywa nusunusu.

target_app_summary: The base obituary portal has grown into a full family memorial platform. Discovery grew via a tag-and-decade browse archive with sorts, an 'On This Date' anniversary lookup, and a keystroke-live headstone inscription designer that engraves epitaphs onto obituary pages. Community grew via a moderated memory-submission workflow, threaded condolence guestbooks whose reply counts feed the archive's busiest-guestbook sort, per-memorial fundraising drives that the archive can filter on, and RSVP headcounts for funeral services. Planning grew via an assigned family task checklist with progress rollups, and the whole app was restyled from peru to forest green. The feature graph has a deep chain (base -> browse archive -> funds/guestbook threading -> restyle) plus several dashboard-anchored workflows, all computing over one pinned set of six memorials.

memories submitted on base obituary pages, moderated in the dashboard
fund drives attach to base obituary pages

RSVPs attach to base funeral arrangement listings
replies extend the base condolence messages
reply counts feed the browse archive's busiest-guestbook sort
checklist progress overview lives on the dashboard
restyles base dashboard and obituary pages
restyles the inscription designer's save button and headings
restyles browse archive cards and tag badges
restyles the dashboard approve button
restyles fund pages and pledge button
restyles service/RSVP pages and RSVP button

global_rules.rule: All dates anywhere in the app are written with the month spelled out, like 'March 12, 1932' — never numeric forms like 03/12/32.
Every deceased person's name, wherever it appears, is followed by their lifespan years in parentheses, e.g. 'Harold Finch (1932–2024)'.
Any action that declines, removes, or deletes content asks for confirmation ('are you sure') first, app-wide.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya blogu ya afya kwa ajili ya kuchapisha makala zinazohusu afya na kuhamasisha maisha yenye afya. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kuchapisha makala, kutoa maoni, kutafuta na kupanga katika makundi. Watumiaji waweze kuvinjari na kutafuta makala, kuandika maoni, na kufuatilia mada mahususi. Chagua misty rose (waridi lenye ukungu) kwa mandharinyuma ya jumla na firebrick (nyekundu ya tofali) kwa vipengele vyote. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa KIINGEREZA. Majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe niliyoyatoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza, na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the homepage of the health blog website and check for the presence of a search bar.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The homepage displays a functional search bar prominently, enabling users to input search queries.

target_app_summary: The little health blog has grown into a full wellness publishing platform. Discovery grew two ways: a filterable, paginated article archive with review-status and read-time screening, and a personalized My Feed that reconciles followed topics with quiz results into a top-two-per-topic list with provenance tags. Engagement grew into per-topic community boards with a reply workflow, a live question router that classifies a typed question onto the right board keystroke-by-keystroke and posts it as a pre-titled thread, and an engagement analytics dashboard that scores articles by views-per-minute and rolls up board activity. An editorial pipeline (Review Desk) gates which articles earn the Medically Reviewed badge, which in turn gates what the weekly digest composer may include — a three-deep chain from the seeded archive through review to the digest. A site-wide visual refresh (teal actions, badge pills, centered headings) ties the surfaces together, and app-wide conventions (min-read formatting, Reviewed/Editorial labels, friendly empty states) are enforced silently on every new surface.

global_rules.rule: Every article, anywhere it appears (lists, search results, quiz recommendations, digest, feed), carries either a 'Medically Reviewed' tag (with the doctor's name where there's room) or an 'Editorial' tag.
Read times are always written as 'X min read' everywhere in the app.
Any empty list or section anywhere shows a friendly nothing-here message with a nudge to act, never a blank area.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya blogu ya mashairi kwa ajili ya kuonyesha na kushiriki maudhui ya kishairi. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kuvinjari mashairi, kutafuta mashairi, kuchapisha mashairi, na kutoa maoni kwenye mashairi. Watumiaji waweze kuvinjari aina mbalimbali za mashairi, kutafuta shairi mahususi, kuchapisha mashairi yao wenyewe, na kutoa maoni kwenye mashairi ya wengine. Tumia light goldenrod (njano ya dhahabu hafifu) kwa mpangilio wa ukurasa; tumia olive drab (kijani cha zeituni kilichofifia) kwa vitufe na kadi. Kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa Kiingereza, na majina ya vipengele, kurasa na vitufe ninayoyatoa katika maombi haya ni ya Kiingereza na yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

ui_instruct.task: Verify the poetry browsing functionality.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can access a list of poetry, with each entry displaying the title and author clearly.

ui_instruct.task: Test the search function by searching for a specific poem title.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The search returns results that include the poem with the matching title and no unrelated results.

ui_instruct.task: Test the process of posting new poetry.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can fill out a form to input poetry title, content, and tags, then submit it successfully; the new poem should appear on the website.

ui_instruct.task: Test the functionality for posting a comment on an existing poem.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can submit a comment, and it appears under the poem along with the user's name and timestamp.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that users can navigate to different types of poetry categories.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Clicking on a category correctly filters and displays poems belonging to that category only.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'light goldenrod' as the background color and 'olive drab' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'light goldenrod' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'olive drab', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: Wasomaji wananiambia mara kwa mara kwamba wanataka kushangilia shairi bila kuandika maoni, kwa hivyo hebu tuongeze ming'aro: 'sparkle button' kwenye kila shairi popote linapoonekana, chenye hesabu inayoendelea, chenye kikomo cha ming'aro 3 kwa kila msomaji kwa kila shairi — baada ya wa tatu kitufe kionyeshe wazi kwamba amefikia kikomo, na kuwe na njia ya kurudisha mng'aro baada ya kubofya kimakosa. Futa mashairi yoyote ya mfano yaliyomo humo na utuanzishe na haya saba hasa, nitaongeza mengine baadaye: Cinders na Mara Voss ('Haiku', mistari 3, ming'aro 12, maoni 1), Harbor Glass na Theo Rin ('Sonnet', mistari 14, ming'aro 9, maoni 4), Wren Song na Mara Voss ('Free Verse', mistari 21, ming'aro 7, maoni 5), Salt Meadow na Ivy Chen ('Haiku', mistari 3, ming'aro 12, maoni 0), The Unsent Letter na Theo Rin ('Free Verse', mistari 30, ming'aro 6, maoni 2), Juniper na Ivy Chen ('Limerick', mistari 5, ming'aro 8, maoni 3), na Night Ferry na Priya Anand ('Sonnet', mistari 14, ming'aro 15, maoni 0). Tunga maandishi ya mashairi na maandishi ya maoni mwenyewe, lakini weka namba hizo sawasawa kabisa, na onyesha idadi ya mistari ya kila shairi pamoja na maelezo yake. Kuna mtindo mmoja wa nyumbani ninaoutaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye: muundo wa shairi (Haiku, Sonnet, Limerick, Free Verse) unaonyeshwa kama beji ndogo ya duara kando kabisa ya kichwa chake, popote shairi linapoonekana.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The sparkle count climbs from 12 to 13, 14, then 15, and the fourth click does not raise it past 15 — the control indicates the 3-sparkle limit is reached.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Cinders' sparkle count reads exactly 13 (12 seeded + 2 given - 1 taken back).

ui_instruct.expected_result: A pill badge reading Limerick sits next to Juniper's title, and the poem shows its line count of 5 lines.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The poem's page shows 10 sparkles — the same count as the browse card after the click, not the seeded 9.

ui_instruct.task: Type Night Ferry into the search box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Night Ferry by Priya Anand appears in the results, and poems that don't match are not shown.

follow_ups.instruction: Wakati wa ukurasa wa mwanzo umefika: nipe ubao unaoitwa 'This Week's Board' unaopanga kila shairi kwa alama za mvuto — ming'aro pamoja na pointi mbili kwa kila maoni — ambapo matatu ya juu yanaonyeshwa kwa ukubwa pamoja na nafasi na alama zao, na mengine yanaorodheshwa kwa mpangilio chini yake. Kutoa mng'aro au kutoa maoni kunapaswa kusogeza ubao mara moja, bila kulazimika kupakia upya. Na kila mashairi mawili yanapolingana katika kitu chochote tunachopanga, yaorodheshe kwa alfabeti kwa kichwa — hiyo iwe sheria kila mahali kwenye programu hii ambapo vitu vinapangwa, sasa na kwa chochote tutakachoongeza baadaye.

follow_ups.instruction: Tovuti inahitaji 'Form Lab' — ukurasa wake wenyewe — ambapo muundo wa shairi unakaguliwa, siyo kupendezwa nao tu. Mimi nachagua muundo lengwa ('Haiku', 'Sonnet', 'Limerick', 'Free Verse'), na kando ya kila chaguo ionyeshwe idadi ya mashairi yaliyochapishwa ya muundo huo ambayo tovuti tayari inayo; kisha ninapoandika au kubandika rasimu kwenye kikaguzi, hesabu ya mistari na hesabu ya maneno zinasasishwa moja kwa moja kwa kila mbonyezo wa kibonye — mistari mitupu ni mipaka ya beti tu na haipaswi kuhesabiwa kama mistari. 'Haiku' ina mistari 3 hasa, 'Limerick' 5, 'Sonnet' 14, 'Free Verse' chochote chenye angalau 1, na kitufe cha 'Certify' kinabaki kimezimwa hadi hesabu ya mistari ilingane na muundo uliochaguliwa. Pia niweze kupakia shairi lolote lililochapishwa kwenye kikaguzi, na kuthibitisha shairi kunaweka alama ya 'form-true' kando ya beji yake popote shairi hilo linapoonekana.
follow_ups.source_feature: Extensive category and tag taxonomy (poetic forms)

ui_instruct.expected_result: The live line counter reads 3 — the blank line is not counted — and the Certify button becomes enabled.

ui_instruct.expected_result: While typing, the line counter reads 2, the word count reads 5, and the Certify button stays disabled — all without pressing any submit.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The checker counts Juniper's 5 lines so the limerick requirement is met and Certify enables; after certifying, Juniper's browse entry shows a form-true mark next to its Limerick pill badge.

ui_instruct.task: Open the homepage and read the This Week's Board top three on a fresh load.

follow_ups.instruction: Hebu tuendeshe shindano letu la kwanza: ukurasa wa 'Contests' unaoandaa 'The Turning Tide', 'Haiku' pekee, kila mshairi aingize shairi moja — unaweza kuingiza mojawapo ya 'Haiku' zako zilizopo au kuandika mpya hapohapo kwenye ukurasa wa 'Contests', na shairi jipya haliwezi kuwasilishwa hadi lipite ukaguzi wa mistari ya 'Haiku' wa 'Form Lab', moja kwa moja unapoandika. Salt Meadow iliingizwa kwanza na Cinders ikafuata mara moja; maingizo yanapangwa kwa idadi ya ming'aro yao. Kitufe cha 'Close Voting' kinatawaza shairi lililo juu kuwa mshindi na kulionyesha kwa fahari kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo. Aa, na kuanzia sasa na kuendelea, popote kwenye programu hii ambapo kitu kinafungwa kabisa au kufutwa kwa kudumu, niulize nithibitishe kabla halijatokea.

follow_ups.instruction: Watunzi wa mashairi wanastahili nafasi yao wenyewe. Jenga orodha ya 'Poets' ambapo kila mshairi anaonekana mara moja tu — hata wale wenye mashairi kadhaa — ikionyesha idadi ya mashairi yao na jumla ya ming'aro ya kazi zao zote, wakipangwa kwa jumla ya ming'aro, wa juu zaidi kwanza. Kubofya mshairi kunafungua wasifu wake wenye muhtasari uleule na mashairi yake, kila moja likiunganisha kurudi kwenye ukurasa wake. Jumla zifuatilie moja kwa moja: mtu akitoa mng'aro kwenye shairi, namba ya mshairi isogee pamoja nayo.

follow_ups.instruction: Makofi ni mazuri, lakini watunzi wa mashairi wanataka maelezo ya kweli. Ongeza swichi ya 'feedback-welcome' wakati wa kuchapisha na kwenye ukurasa wa shairi, ambayo inaweka beji kwenye shairi na kuliorodhesha kwenye 'Critique Corner' mpya; uhakiki wa hapo ni kitu chenye muundo wake — jina la mhakiki, kiini (taswira, 'rhythm', au uteuzi wa maneno), na maelezo ya angalau herufi 30, na chochote kifupi zaidi kikataliwe kwa ujumbe ulio wazi. Panga kona kwa idadi ndogo zaidi ya uhakiki kwanza ili mashairi yaliyopuuzwa yajitokeze. Anza na Wren Song na The Unsent Letter yakiwa yamewekewa alama ya 'feedback-welcome' — Rhea Solano tayari ameyahakiki yote mawili, na Sam Kade ameacha mmoja kwenye The Unsent Letter — na mshairi anapohisi amemaliza, anaweka ombi kuwa 'resolved', jambo linaloliondoa kwenye kona na kuweka mhuri wa 'Critiqued' kwenye shairi.

follow_ups.instruction: Wasomaji wanapaswa kupata nafasi ya kujifungia kijitabu chao kidogo cha mashairi. Ipe kila shairi kidhibiti cha kuongeza kwenye 'My Anthology' na ujenge ukurasa wa 'My Anthology' wenye onyesho la awali linalokusanywa moja kwa moja: jumla ya mistari, mchanganuo kwa muundo, na makadirio ya muda wa kusoma wa sekunde nne kwa kila mstari, yaliyopandishwa hadi nusu dakika iliyo karibu zaidi — sekunde 196 zinapaswa kusomeka 3.5 min, na hata 'Haiku' moja pekee ionyeshe 0.5 min, kamwe siyo sifuri. Jumuisha kizuizi cha maandishi cha yaliyomo kinachoweza kunakiliwa, kilichopangwa kwa muundo — makundi ya miundo kwa mpangilio wa alfabeti, na vichwa kwa alfabeti ndani ya kila kundi — pamoja na kidhibiti cha mbofyo mmoja cha "add-this-week's-top-three" kinachovuta chochote kinachoongoza ubao kwa sasa. Na mkusanyiko mtupu uonyeshe ujumbe wa kirafiki wa kuhamasisha, siyo nafasi tupu au takwimu za sifuri.

follow_ups.instruction: Kilele cha msimu: jenga ukurasa wa 'Season Laurels' unaokusanya taji nne kiotomatiki — 'Most Sparkled' (idadi kubwa zaidi ya ming'aro), 'Board Champion' (yeyote aliye #1 kwenye ubao wa wiki hii), 'Contest Laureate' (mshindi wa shindano lililofungwa — kama upigaji kura bado uko wazi, sema hivyo na uache taji hilo likisubiri), na 'Top Critic' (yeyote aliyeandika uhakiki mwingi zaidi kwenye 'Critique Corner') — kila moja lionyeshwe pamoja na namba yake ili niweze kuhakiki. Hadi litakapochapishwa, hakuna kitu chochote cha kitaji kinachopaswa kuonekana popote.

target_app_summary: The poetry blog has grown into a full community poetry platform. Readers cheer poems with capped, retractable sparkles; a homepage This Week's Board ranks poems by a buzz score of sparkles plus weighted comments; and a Form Lab checks haiku/limerick/sonnet line counts live per keystroke and certifies poems as form-true. On top of these grew a haiku contest with sparkle-driven voting and a crowned winner, a deduplicated Poets roster ranked by rolled-up sparkle totals, a structured Critique Corner peer-feedback workflow, a chapbook anthology builder with computed line totals, rounded read times, and a grouped table-of-contents export, and a Season Laurels ceremony that reconciles the board, contest, sparkles, and critiques into published awards. A mid-ladder restyle (plum buttons, centered serif headings, cream cards, amber sparkle counts, outlined form badges) sweeps four pages. The graph runs deep: sparkles feed the board, roster, contest, and laurels; the Form Lab's line check gates fresh contest entries; and the board's top three feed the anthology importer — so early breakage compounds through the late turns.

global_rules.rule: Every poem's form (Haiku, Sonnet, Limerick, Free Verse) is shown as a small pill badge next to its title, everywhere a poem appears.
Any ranked or ordered list breaks ties alphabetically (by poem title or poet name).
Anything closed out or deleted for good asks for confirmation before it happens.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya mti wa viungo kwa ajili ya kuonyesha na kudhibiti viungo. Tovuti iwe na uwezo wa kuongeza, kuhariri na kufuta viungo. Watumiaji waweze kuunda na kudhibiti mti wao wa viungo — kuongeza viungo vipya, kuhariri viungo vilivyopo, kufuta viungo visivyohitajika, na kushiriki mti wao wa viungo na wengine kupitia kiungo cha kushiriki cha mti wa viungo. Weka mandharinyuma ya jumla kuwa papaya whip (krimu ya papai), kisha upe vipengele mtindo wa rangi ya dark orange (chungwa iliyokolea). target_app_summary: The one-page link tree has grown into a full creator link-in-bio platform. A click analytics dashboard (seeded with seven exact links and counts) feeds nearly everything: a public visitor Preview whose button clicks increment the counts, schedule windows with a typed viewing-as-of date simulator, group sections with click rollups, pin/move ordering that the Preview mirrors, a click-goals tracker whose bars move when visitors click, and a copyable weekly Digest that composes totals, top link, goal progress, and upcoming scheduled links. A teal-on-white rebrand restyles the manager, Analytics, and Preview, and a multi-step profile wizard publishes an initials-avatar header onto the Preview and signs the Digest. The graph has two deep chains (analytics -> preview -> scheduling -> digest -> profile, and analytics -> preview -> groups -> ordering), so early breakage compounds through the ladder.

global_rules.rule: Click counts are always written with comma thousands separators followed by the word 'clicks' (e.g. '2,450 clicks'), never bare digits, on every surface now and later.
A link's status is always shown as a colored pill badge — green when publicly visible, gray when not — never plain text, on every surface now and later.
Any newly created link starts as Hidden until explicitly toggled Live, wherever in the app it gets created.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti ya kazi za kukokotoa kwa ajili ya kufanya hesabu. Tovuti inapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kuingiza vielezi vya hisabati, kutekeleza hesabu, na kuonyesha matokeo. Watumiaji waweze kuingiza vielezi vya hisabati, kuchagua aina ya hesabu (kwa mfano 'Basic Arithmetic'), kutekeleza hesabu, na kuona matokeo ya hesabu. Tumia mint cream (krimu ya mnanaa) kama mandharinyuma ya skrini na teal (buluu-kijani) kwa mwangaza wa vipengele. Zaidi ya hayo, kiolesura chote kinachoonekana cha tovuti — lebo zote, vitufe, vichwa, menyu, ujumbe na maudhui — lazima kiwe kwa KIINGEREZA; majina ya vipengele, ya kurasa na ya vitufe ninayoyatoa katika maombi haya yako kwa Kiingereza na lazima yatumike hasa kama yalivyoandikwa.

Nianzishie na hizi saba zikiwa tayari zimewekwa, zimeorodheshwa kuanzia ya zamani hadi mpya ili ujue mpangilio: sqrt(1444) = 38 (Scientific), 40+2 = 42 (Arithmetic), 15% ya 212 = 31.8 (Percent), 2^10 = 1024 (Scientific), 10.7/4 = 2.675 (Arithmetic), 12*(8-3) = 60 (Arithmetic), 3^5 = 243 (Scientific) — hizi hasa, mimi nitarundika nyingine juu yake. Jambo lingine la mtindo kwa programu nzima kuanzia sasa: jibu lolote lililokokotolewa, popote linapoonekana sasa au baadaye, lionyeshwe kwa fonti ya monospace likiwa na alama ya usawa mbele yake, kama = 42.

target_app_summary: The one-page expression calculator has grown into a full computing workbench. The original evaluator is now surrounded by a persistent, filterable calculation history (seeded with seven pinned entries), a user-defined variables library that substitutes named values into expressions live while keeping variable names visible in logged expressions, a save/restore workflow for keeper calculations, and a display-settings engine (decimal places, half-up rounding, scientific notation) whose formatting flows into every surface. On top of the history sit a stats dashboard with tie-aware category rollups and a checkbox-driven report builder with on-screen copyable output; alongside sit a live unit converter and an everything-search page that hunts through history entries, saved calculations, and variables with every keystroke, matching result values as well as expression text. A final app-wide restyle unifies calculator, history, stats, and converter. The feature graph is history-centric: the history feeds formatting, stats, reports, and the live search, with the precision engine forming a second hub, giving chains four turns deep from the base calculator.

global_rules.rule: Every calculated result, on every surface, is displayed in a monospace font prefixed with an equals sign, e.g. '= 42'.

instruction: Tafadhali tengeneza tovuti mahiri ya ndoa ambapo watumiaji wanaweza kutafuta wenzi wa maisha. Tovuti iwe na usajili wa mtumiaji na kuingia kwenye akaunti, ili watumiaji waweze kutengeneza wasifu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kupakia picha na kujaza taarifa binafsi. Tovuti pia iwe na ujumbe na gumzo, ili watumiaji waweze kuwasiliana wao kwa wao. Buni tovuti ukitumia rangi ya 'lemon chiffon' (njano hafifu ya limau) kwa mandharinyuma na 'chocolate' (kahawia ya chokoleti) kwa vizuizi vya maudhui. follow_ups.instruction: Tuongeze 'kundali matching tool' kwenye ukurasa wake mwenyewe — kwa kila mmoja kati ya watu wawili mimi huchagua 'moon sign', gana (Deva, Manushya au Rakshasa), na nadi (Adi, Madhya au Antya), na alama hujihesabu upya papo hapo kila sehemu inapobadilika, bila kitufe cha kutuma. Uhesabuji unakwenda hivi: nadi hutoa pointi 8 pale nadi za wawili hao zinapotofautiana (vinginevyo 0); gana hutoa 6 kwa gana moja, 5 kwa Deva na Manushya, 1 kwa Manushya na Rakshasa, na 0 kwa Deva na Rakshasa; na elementi zinazolingana hutoa 7 — moto ni Aries/Leo/Sagittarius, ardhi ni Taurus/Virgo/Capricorn, hewa ni Gemini/Libra/Aquarius, na maji ni Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces. Mpaka sehemu zote sita zijazwe, onyesha ujumbe wa kirafiki badala ya namba yoyote. target_app_summary: The matrimonial site has grown from a profile-search-and-chat app into a full matchmaking suite. Discovery got deeper: a live Ashtakoota kundali calculator, a partner-preferences match meter that scores and ranks every member, and a verified-only trust layer stacked onto search. Relationship workflows grew around a pinned seven-member community: an interests hub with received/sent/connection states, a Quick Connect speed-matching night whose mutuals feed straight into connections, and an activity dashboard that rolls all of it up (acceptance rate, average match of connections). Privacy controls with a live self-preview gate messaging by verification or connection status, and a compatibility report builder fuses the kundali rules, match meter, verified badges, and connections into one on-screen shareable document. A royal ivory-maroon-gold restyle mid-way re-skins every surface built so far. The graph runs several chains deep: interests -> speed matching -> dashboard, and calculator/preferences/verification all converge into the final report.

global_rules.rule: Every compatibility or match score anywhere in the app carries a verdict tag: Strong when at least two-thirds of its maximum, Weak when under one-third, Moderate in between.
Any decline, withdraw, or remove action anywhere in the app asks for confirmation before it happens.
Ages are always displayed in the form '27 yrs' everywhere in the app.

follow_ups.instruction: Sehemu ya kuvinjari inahitaji kukua na kuwa kivinjari cha kweli. Ijaze na kazi hizi nane hasa, nitaongeza nyingine baadaye: Nebula Whale ya Mira Chen ('Digital Art', lebo space na animals, mionekano 1200, mapendwa 320 ambapo 12 kati yake yalipatikana wiki hii, maoni 14); Clockwork Garden ya Theo Voss ('Sculpture', steampunk na nature, mionekano 800, mapendwa 210, 45 wiki hii, maoni 8); Paper Dragons ya Mira Chen ('Papercraft', fantasy na animals, mionekano 940, mapendwa 180, 45 wiki hii, maoni 22); Midnight Library ya Sana Okafor ('Digital Art', fantasy na architecture, mionekano 2100, mapendwa 450, 8 wiki hii, maoni 31); Rust & Roses ya Theo Voss ('Photography', nature na urban, mionekano 640, mapendwa 95, 30 wiki hii, maoni 5); Glass Comet ya Lena Petrov ('Sculpture', space, mionekano 1500, mapendwa 275, 61 wiki hii, maoni 17); Ink Tempest ya Sana Okafor ('Digital Art', abstract, mionekano 430, mapendwa 60, 2 wiki hii, maoni 3); na Origami Tide ya Lena Petrov ('Papercraft', nature na abstract, mionekano 1100, mapendwa 95, 19 wiki hii, maoni 9). Nipe kichagua kategoria pamoja na chipu za lebo zinazobonyezwa: kuchagua lebo kadhaa kunaonyesha kazi yoyote yenye lebo mojawapo kati ya hizo (kila kazi mara moja tu, hakuna marudio!), huku kategoria na lebo zikipunguzana, pamoja na hesabu ya papo hapo inayoonyesha ni ngapi kati ya hizo 8 zinaonekana, na chaguo linaloitwa 'sort-by-likes' ambapo kazi zenye idadi sawa hupangwa kwa alfabeti ya kichwa. Vitu viwili ninavyovitaka kila mahali kwenye programu hii kuanzia sasa, si hapa tu: hesabu yoyote ya elfu moja au zaidi ionyeshwe kwa ufupi ikiwa na desimali moja, kama 1.2k, na lebo ziwe na # mbele daima.

follow_ups.instruction: Nataka ukurasa mdogo wa kuchezea unaoitwa 'Spark Score': andika mionekano, mapendwa na maoni kisha ihesabu alama papo hapo unapoandika — sehemu ya kumi ya pointi kwa kila mwonekano, pointi 2 kwa kila pendwa, 5 kwa kila maoni, ikionyeshwa kwa desimali moja. Chini ya 50 ni 'Ember', kuanzia 50 hadi 150 ni 'Flame', 150 na kuendelea ni 'Blaze'; onyesha daraja hilo kando kabisa ya alama. Ongeza kichagua kinachojaza namba hizo mapema kutoka kwa kazi yoyote iliyo kwenye kivinjari, na mtu akiandika kitu hasi au kisicho namba, mwonye kwa upole badala ya kuonyesha takataka. Aa, na kila mara kitu chochote kwenye programu hii kinapokosa cha kuonyesha — ukurasa huu kabla ya namba kuingizwa, orodha yoyote inayotokea tupu, sasa na daima — usiache nafasi tupu kamwe; weka ujumbe mdogo wa kuchekesha wenye neno 'spark'.

target_app_summary: World of Imagination grows from a simple showcase-and-discuss site into a full creative community platform. Discovery gets a real gallery explorer with category/tag cross-filtering and tie-aware sorting over a pinned set of eight works, plus a Spark Score calculator that turns engagement numbers into tiered scores. Social mechanics arrive as a heart/favorites system whose live counts ripple outward into a Weekly Spotlight leaderboard, a per-artist insights dashboard built on the Spark formula, and community-run challenges that crown champions back on the gallery cards. Communities themselves become a multi-page workflow (browse, create with validation, join, post in pinned threads), and everything feeds a notification bell with a filterable activity feed. A late full-app restyle sweeps coral accents, centered serif headings, and a consistent card treatment across every surface. The feature graph fans out from the explorer (T2) into hearts, the calculator prefill, and challenges, with deep chains like explorer to hearts to spotlight and explorer to calculator to artist analytics.

global_rules.rule: Any displayed count of 1000 or more is shown compact with one decimal, like 1.2k, everywhere in the app.
Tags are always rendered with a leading # (e.g. #space) on every surface.
Nothing empty is ever left blank: any empty view or empty result set shows a playful note that mentions a spark.
